review_text: The first impression was poor....  the staff was not rude by any means, how ever they were not the five star service I expected. Our waiter was very informative & pleasant though!

Went there for the manny-mayweather fight. The tv's where plentiful. The wings where hot and good. The bad: waitress service was slow and rude, drinks where all messed up from the beginning, bathrooms where a mess. Should of went to the tilted kilt for better looking women.

Wow terrible service. Rude staff dead flies everywhere. No one cleans counter. Standing water at water stand.
Stay away!!!!

Worst was recommended by a waiter at The Don Cezar Hotel service was rude at best the waiter could careless the bartender didn't know how to make a Cosmo and the food was pretty average.
I wouldn't recommend it.

Absolutely terrible meal and ridiculously overpriced 

Waiter fail to check in the table. Literally had to find him to get water refills.  

Charges gratuity for party's of seven and didn't even notify us ahead of time.  

Also extremely slow slow slow service.

Slow service and a bartender with a major attitude. I think her name was Melissa and she was very unfriendly and rude to us and other patrons. The steak sliders were horrible but the wings were pretty good.

After ordering for many years we are done. Very pricey for bad food. This place has gone down hill. Horrible service. Rude owner. I will never go there again!!! The person who took order could was incredibly rude. Phil's is welcoming and the food is so much better!!!

This is the worst Applebee's of all time. Everyone who works there is slow and incredibly rude. It takes them forever to do anything because the employees are all lazy. The restaurant is frequently dirty. No.
Terribly rude waiter threw the checkbook on the table after adding a tip to our bill. We were four people. Overpriced food and VERY small portions. I would not recommend eating here.
Mediocre food, very slow service and higher prices. At least for takeout anyway.

Poor customer service. A waiter spilled butter on my wife and the managers were reluctant to admit it was a mistake and apologize. Wait staff was slow and not very observant. Worst service I have ever had at a restaurant.
Manager Candice Robinson.  Terribly slow.  Rude staff.  Avoid this location if possible.

The food is good, but the lady behind the counter was rude and patronizing. They charged an extra 2$ for oysters and I didn't realize it. When I went back to ask about what I spent my money on the white chick was rude and condescending. However, the other people were genuinely sweet. I would recommend this place but the one employee needs some education in customer service. Rude.
Extremely slow service... Even on a slow night! Took forever for our appetizers to come out, and our entrees, oh and desert as well!
Service was slow. Staff was non attentive. Almost at a snobby level. We ordered appetizers, waiter forgot. We are party of 2, tables with more people revived more attention.

Worst service and rude ownership.  Our first bad experience but will never return.  Was appalled at their lack of caring that our food showed up sporadically and incorrect.  Asked for the manager and was told no.  Last visit.
The Food was good ......the service was VERY slow!   I liked the food to put up the slow service. It appears to have gone out of business.....
We went here in spite of terrible reviews and a friend claiming to have become sick after eating here. The food and staff were both excellent! We definitely plan to return again soon.
Pleasantly surprised. The food was excellent and well proportioned and the staff was super friendly.

Daniel and his staff were excellent.  Brian was our sever, and his recommendation along with his service - can't say enough.  I was out with my parents for my moms birthday, and they made it enjoyable.
Sitting at Dukes having my first sandwich and beer. Great atmosphere, amazing music, even better sandwiches. Will absolutely come back. Very friendly staff and excellent service.
I'm not a vegetarian but I loved this place. Great food and excellent service. Can't wait to go back!
It was our first time and we will definitely be back! Excellent food, excellent service. Owners are on-site and personable. Taylor was our waitress and was terrific!
Very good!  Okra fries are awesome.  The charbroiled oysters and the blistered peppers are among my favorites here.  Drinks are good and the bar staff is excellent!  One of my favorite places.
Service and food is always EXCELLENT!!! The staff are friendly! The cashiers always have a smile on their face even when customers are sometimes RUDE! I hope management pays them for their WORTH!!!

Everything about this place was awesome! The food was delicious. The service was exceptional. The prices are reasonable. The staff are very friendly.

I had the Shrimp Portofino which was excellent.  I will definitely be back!

Excellent food and service! Staff was very friendly. The dog patio was very convenient  and my dog really enjoyed it. Highly recommend stopping by here for breakfast or lunch. Prices were also generally inexpensive.
Cheese curds and pickled veggies are amazing! Waiting staff is always excellent. When in doubt, get the French Breakfast. Only complaint is the Mex burger is off the menu. #BringBackTheMex
Delish! Will definitely be back. So staff extremely friendly, great atmosphere and excellent portion sizes.
First time coming here at it was okay.....service was excellent and staff very friendly! Clean tables. Food was okay, not much flavor. Chili was on the watery side.
Delicious food and friendly staff...a proper little gem!
Coffee is excellent. Food was good. Customer service is excellent. Very friendly staff. Great atmosphere. Very popular place. Steady flow of customers. Enjoyed our experience.
Excellent food, great prices, super clean, friendly staff. Enjoyed our dinner... we'll be back soon!
Fantastic restaurant. Excellent service and food!!

Very friendly staff, excellent service. I was greeted by a friendly cashier who was polite and quick. I wasn't even done filling my drink and my food was already up. From the time I walked in the door to having sat down with my food was less than five minutes. I got the sampler for $4.99 and it was hot and tasted fresh.
I ordered the Crawfish Creole for breakfast with 2 eggs, Swiss cheese, hash browns and toast.  I really enjoyed it and the service was excellent and super friendly staff. Another must try.

An absolute wonderful experience!! I've been waiting to try Juniors and I'm sad I waited so long! The drinks were wonderful and the food was excellent. I highly recommend the Korean philly cheese steak. I could not believe how great it was. Additionally, the atmosphere is great for a one on one date or catching up with a friend. 10/10 from me!
The good has always been good and the service too.  Sometimes the wait can be a little long to get your food but they always get my steak right and that's an accomplishment around here!

We finally tried Woody's and my only complaint is that we waited so long! It's so good. I think they are busier during the week due to location so weekends are more mellow which is great. Each booth has its own little tv. The menu is great and the food is really tasty.

-  Too much food.
-  Too expensive when you're cooking it yourself.
-  Took too long to get food.

+  Even though the food took awhile, the service was good, our server was efficient and genuinely friendly.
+  The atmosphere was nice, intimate.

So, I love love love love love chipotle. I was driving north for Easter, and decided I absolutely had to have some. So I pulled over, looked up the nearest chipotle, and off I went. This chipotle is located in a mall - but not in the food court. It's on the opposite side of the mall from the food court. A bit difficult to locate. I waited in line for a bit, and then they were out of steak. So I waited a bit more. Then I enquired as to how long it would be, because if it would be a while, I had no problem with chicken. They said no, it was almost done. So I waited a bit more. Meanwhile the line of people behind me had learned what not to order, and had all checked out, so the cashier took a break.

Long story short - My burrito was delicious, the service was slow, but I got my meal for free so I'd give them a second shot. They knew they had messed up and made up for it.

I visited Pickles and Swiss on a recent Friday around 1pm.  I had heard good things and we needed a quick lunch so I was excited to order a sandwich.  There was no line to order but all the seats were full so it was clearly a busy afternoon.  We waited at least 20-25 minutes for two cold sandwiches (too long - another person near me mentioned how long she was waiting too).  From what I saw from where I waited I became pretty disgusted.  One employee seemed to be making almost all the sandwiches even though there were three others milling around.  He had all the sandwiches in process laying open on the counter in front of him, with one or two ingredients on each.  That seems like a very inefficient way to make sandwiches and means many people were just standing around waiting.  I watched him spread egg salad on a piece of bread (this ultimately became my sandwich) and then leave it sitting for another 10 minutes while he worked on other orders.  I later watched him chop bacon, wipe the knife on a dirty towel, and cut the avocado for my sandwich.  I did eat the sandwich because I was hungry and had paid for it.  The sandwich was bland and all I could think about was how unsanitary everything was I had watched.
Had to wait a long time to get the bartenders attention for a drink in the lobby lounge.  Was I invisible?  Waited on others who came to the bar behind me.

Amazing place! The food was the most delicious breakfast food I had when I was in NOLA. Our waitress was very prompt and helpful the entire time even though it was super busy. We waited a long time to get our food but it was completely worth it.

Their food is very delicious, but the server is terrible. 
We waited for a long time. There was a table placed their order after us and they got their food much faster than us. I saw we ordered the similar food. We are a party of two, not a big party. 
We waited for a while to get the check, at the same time I saw the server was texting and just standing there, i waved to her, I don't know if she was ignoring us or not.
Over-rated with not worth waiting so long food and drinks. Apart from the  location which I think that too is better 2 miles down at the marina, nothing great about this place.
Not sure what was the reason why it took so long for our food to arrive but waited 35min. But the servers were nice and food was good. I'd recommend the rueben sandwich.
Delicious!  We went on the second night of their soft opening and while the wait was long, the food was great and so was the service.

Waited 30 minutes for a sandwich that was too hot to touch. Needed to leave by the time I received my sandwich that I planned on eating in & waited another 5 minutes for a paper bag and a lid - no to go boxes?

Figure it out.

Came for the roast beef, waited 30 minutes for my sandwich to come out (wanted to see how long it'll take), told them to take it back after waiting 40 minutes. But on a good note, the customers are cool. A few people took note of my long wait and ordered me a beer. With that said, eat in advance!

Drink thru order almost $30.00 during lunch time. Took forever for order to be taken. Waited almost 20 minutes after paying for food. Fries were either raw or burnt.When i finally received the order I asked why it took so long, she said we're busy it's lunch.

This place is awful.  Went in there for a slice of plain pizza one day and waited at least 20 minutes for them to finally bring it to me.  In the mean time someone came in to pick up a pepperoni pizza and they must have had too many plain slices ready at the time so instead of making her a pepperoni pizza, they headers up right plain slices, put pepperoni on them and carefully placed them in a circle in the box.  Absolutely awful.  Would never wait that long for any pizza nonetheless a slice of just ok pizza that took ridiculously long to get.  

In addition , they call themselves a brick oven pizzeria but they DONT HAVE A BRICK OVEN!!  Wouldn't waste time or money here again.

Waited a long time just for our drinks. Mine tasted nothing like a Long Island and didn't seem to have any liquor in it. However the wizard fries were pretty good and the cheese cake was delicious. The wait and the service was crap it wasn't busy at all.

Closest pizza to Brooklyn, New York! You can buy by the slice for around $2.50. I recommend asking for it well done to get that crispy crust. If I had to compare it to Brooklyn's Pizza off of 4th Avenue in Tucson: I'd say Mario's is better! 
It isn't in the best part of town, but the best food is in the ghetto lol
Some of the best pizza I have ever had. Wish there was more seating, your best bet is carry-out. Get the thick crust, you won't be sorry!
The best PIZZA anywhere near NY.... I love this place and will come here every single time i am in Boise...  Thanks for the juicy pizza

Totally love Mellow Mushroom in Clearwater. The tortilla soup is vegetarian and to die for. They have great salad choices. Fun appetizers and of course the pizza is great! Chad and Khrissy are two of the best bartenders in town

Best pizza and service in town!

I would highly recommend Taffy's for pizza- they have the most delicious pizzas, pesto breadsticks, and IPAs, and their management team is so awesome!  They also have a great back patio for events or for hanging out in the summer!!

Simply the best pizza in town.  Moist crust with fresh toppings, this place never fails to deliver.  And speaking of delivery, it's fast and easy.  White pizza with broccoli, spinach and garlic is sensational, as are the sauce pizza too.  Mega Fries may send your cholesterol soaring, but worth every tab of Crestor you may need.  Try the Chicken Cheesesteak too, you won't be disappointed. Everything we have ever ordered (except for the wings) are the best of its kind.  Not to be missed, try this place you will never order from anywhere else again.
This is the best pizza in the valley, and compared to other pizza we have had, there's just no going back.
Best Pizza in Franklin. The service is always outstanding. We're usually here once a week with our toddler and everyone is so nice.

Me and the fiancee stop here for pizza on occasion. The pizza is very good, our favorite in town (Pesto, ricotta, pepperoni, Italian sausage). Wine selection is also very good. Staff service is excellent and I've never had pause or complaint. The Cannolis are our favorite in town. Location is excellent, and the nearby Imax is also a treat.
HANDS DOWN BEST PIZZA SHOP IN AND AROUND TOWN.  i love this pizza shop has been around for awhile owner and staff are all friendly. the pizza is amazing and pastas dinners are always on point.
the best pizza i've ever had!! definitely recommend the margarita pizza it is amazing! will definitely be going back

Man oh Man, If you like Pizza or Calzones, THIS IS THE Best place in town. My friend introduced this place to me while I was at work and came back with a calzone. I am from New Jersey and absolutely love pizza, calzones, strombolies and on the east coast they are the Best. Until now!!!! I have been looking for my pizza place here in reno for years and have found my one and only. PAPA G'S. They are the best in town. If you dont believe me go try it and let me know what you think. I love this place and I have found my home for all of my cravings. Thank you guys for making the BEST food in Reno!!!!

Easily the Best Thai restaurant in town if not one of the best restaurants in town. The guy replying with the bad comment I don't personally believe has ever eaten there or has no taste in food. This food is generally authentic and VERY fresh and VERY good. There is no better value for great food in town. The selection is amazing and also... some of the best Sushi in town from a sushi fanatic.. thats right.. amazing Thai and sushi in one place!

I was looking for pizza, and saw the reviews for SLICE.  I have to say it's the best I've had in Tampa.  Being from Chicago, having worked in pizza joints as a kid, I have an appreciation for the pie.  This is flavorful, tasty pizza.  Crust is soft, as probably an indication of the belt-fed style oven.  If you put this in a stone deck oven it'd probably crisp up nicely.  Staff was friendly, getting the military discount was nice, but not expected.  Will definitely be my choice for pizza when I'm in town, which is a couple times per year.  Definitely worth the drive if you're not in the area.

Not going to write much because I am slipping into a  heavenly food coma. OMG! THIS IS THE BEST PIZZA I HAVE EVER EATEN! My husband and I are in town and wanted pizza. The reviews and pictures sold us. Cherry on top the late night delivery.. SAY WHAT.. amazing pizza. Ever time I visit I plan to order from here.
Renzis has good pizza but it's not the best. The pizza fries are so much better than old English.

Ciconte's greatly exceeded my expectations.  Their mild buffalo wings are uniquely sauced and are the best in town.  Very meaty and large.  They make great pizza and the tomato pie is highly recommended.
One word.. heavenly. Hands down best pizza I've ever had in my life! Margherita is the way to go
This is by far my favorite pizza in town. Tasty toppings and the different crust options and flavors are great. The cheesy bread is also very good.

I ordered a medium well steak, and I got it and it was cold and dry! It was well, well done. Also, I ordered baby green beans and they were also pretty cold once biting into them. The service was great, just not some much the food. We also got kids chicken tenders and they were hard to cut and even to bite into... Very disappointed !

I have been going to this restaurant since they opened. I went to dinner on Tuesday night and unfortunately it will probably be my last time. The last two times I went the food was subpar. Tuesday was worse. My daughter had seafood enchiladas and I had the Tuesday special steak Mexicano  my daughters enchiladas were dried out and the beans were as if they came out of a can. My diner was not much better. The steak was full of gristle the tomatoes they put on the steak were cold the steak was over cooked and the beans were like my daughters and the rice was dry and cold. It saddens me that this is happening.
Cold food is not appetizing.  One other car there and I got cold food.  No excuse for that.

Not so good for take out. Very cold food and we picked up.
Fried rice not so good
Beef was burnt
Surprised since we ate there before.
Buyer beware

Ordered breakfast. The biggest one they had. 
Cold...luke warm at best.
Sausage tasted ok, but cold.
Bacon was good, but cold.
Steak...Tough and cold.
Eggs - Flat, come on....they are scrambled... fluff them up a bit!
Toast, slightly burned.
Service was OK, except I think they left my food on the counter too long before they brought it.
Was anybody paying attention in the kitchen before they sent this out?
I will try the other places before I come back.

The staff was extremely rude. Food was cold. I was soooo dissatisfied that I took time out of my today to type a review. This is literally the first time I have ever left a review about anything. Beware of undercooked and under seasoned/ unflavored food. If I could give negative stars I would.
Pizza crust is undercooked so badly it was inedible; could only eat the edges.  Bad in every sense.

This place is filthy.  Went for breakfast and ordered eggs and hashbrowns, my partner ordered pancakes.  The sides of the table was sticky and dusty.  The hashbrowns were undercooked red potatoes, the eggs cold, and the pancakes must have had no baking powder as they were thick dense and tasteless.  How do places like this stay in business?  I also checked out their grill and it looks like it has not been cleaned in years.  If gets a star  because I can't rate zero.

I used to LOVE Kanella. I was so excited to bring my boyfriend here from Baltimore. And wow was I embarrassed. The service was cold. The food was cold. We were rushed. Appetizers came after drinks - well after. An ordered second cocktail was entirely forgotten. 

It was really sad. Kanella is a place I have recommended, and loved, for years.
Cold food, small tables with huge plates, paid 10.00 for parking. Nothing special. There are so many better places.
I was served an undercooked pizza, which made me Ill for 2 days. I understand that this could be a fluke, as everyone else's food was fine. Hence the 2-star review. It's a weak 2, though.
Disgusting undercooked food, chicken tenders were the size of turkey breast. Pathetic food and service.

Overpriced, mediocre, cold food!
If your looking for good food at a fair price, this is NOT the place for you. If you enjoy pulling all the cheese off of the paper they wrap the sandwich in, definitely go here. 
This place is a one and done for my wife and I.

Place is trash. Spent $80 on three meals and sides, delivery driver dropped off the order missing sides, cold food, tiny servings. Tried to call no one answered. Read the other Yelp reviews, turns out I should have done that first.
Poor meal. Chicken undercooked. Extras that were paid for - not included. Pasta had no sauce.

Had Easter Sunday Brunch in the Grand Ballroom today, the food was nothing special, the shrimp cocktail was undercooked, the new york strip roast was way too undercooked even for those who like rare, and the potato casserole was undercooked.   Have to say it was a real disappointment, if it were not for the excellent wait staff I would rate this a 1 Star but the service was excellent.   Definitely not worth $55 for a very small selection on the buffet and the price did not even include the Mimosa!

Definitely not authentic. Black eye peas were like refried Beans, chicken fried steak tasted as if it came out of a TV dinner. Service was ok at best. They spent to much on decor and zero on food quality. Jiffy style corn bread and undercooked greens. Must I go on? Very disappointed, I am a fan of Midtown restaurants. Stay away if you are hungry because that is how you will leave.

business_name: The Red Cedar Grill and Cocktails
review_text: We tried The Red Cedar for the first time last night. It is a nice place and the service was good. The rolls and butter were yummy. We both ordered the rib eye steak done medium. My steak was more like medium-rare, on the redder, rather than pink side. My husband's was done correctly. The steak was also not seasoned very well with salt and pepper. We had to add quite a bit for flavor. The vegetables were undercooked and on the crunchy side. We would like to go back another time and try something else on the menu.

this place sucks they are rude and my food was cold not only was my food cold the delivery person dropped my pizza and was like it's ok cause it didn't fall out the box what type of mess is that!!!! never again. i give 0 stars.
The sushi is great, atmosphere is decent, staff is good.. Prices are okay too. Over all I'd recommend you try it out!!

We were celebrating our daughters birthday at Sushi Club upon her request. My wife is not a fish person so she ordered off the menu. She ended getting chicken teriyaki, salad, and miso soup (no picture). The rest of us went with the all you can eat sushi. My daughter started off with crab Rangoon's and I had shrimp tempura. Pretty tasty. We ended up ordering several rolls both raw and cooked. We also ordered sashimi and nigiri (tuna and red snapper). You can order cooked rolls, raw rolls, Nigiri (fish on top of rice), and sashimi. The rolls and fish were fresh and delicious. My wife thought her food was average but will explore their menu for other non-fish items. I thought the all you can eat sushi menu gave you many different options to include appetizers, noodles, salad, soups, noodles, fried rice, and sushi. There were several servers working so we always had full glasses of water and pop.  Can't wait to go back and try something new!

This is a fun place if you can find it! I went there with my daughter and her friends after they worked out at Tulane. We ate at the bar. I think most had the quesadillas, which I tried. It was great! I had the fish tacos and they were perfectly crunchy. The service was great. We were in a hurry so that's all we had, but I'd go back.
Nice new place! Sushi and sashimi for 1 was fantastic!  Veggie bento was awesome and the black dragon and caterpillar rolls were great! Very fresh fish! Not too much rice on the rolls!

The service was sub-par and so was the food. We sat at the sushi bar and instead of seeing the fresh fish through the little window, there was a box of gloves and some random plates. The sushi was not the freshest.
This is the only Chinese food i get in Lower Bucks, its great. Delivery service is super quick AND they offer sushi too. Great place, we dont go anywhere else.
Great fresh sushi. One of the best in town. The only bad thing is their website is pretty much non existent so you can order online or anything
very convenient; nice atmosphere; very good service; appropriate pricing; very accommodating; a good place for fresh sushi.
This place is amazing, best sushi joint! Great service, fish is so fresh, delicious rolls and nigiri. Our new go to sushi joint.

This is possibly my favorite sushi place in Philly. The ambiance isn't awesome, but the service is attentive, and the food is great. They have a bunch of interesting/creative rolls, and the fish is fresh and tasty. Plus the rolls are pretty large.
Good variety of Asian food including fresh sushi and Seafood. Priced right. Not overly salty. Fast and convenient. Always has the neighborhood smelling delicious!
Great, fresh Sushi and a nice setting. Also, you can create your own rolls if you want. The Godzilla roll is delicious!!!

Samurai Sushi is not what I expected. I am a huge sushi eater and decided to try this place based on the tremendous reviews. The inside is very small so expect to wait. It doesnt remind me of a typical sushi place; it is a bit warm and outdated. However, the sushi was not bad. The prices were extremely reasonable and the fish tasted relatively fresh. Rating is based on comparison to other sushi restaurants and quality of sushi. I would go back here for a a safe sushi dinner option.

We have been searching for a good sushi place in Reno for awhile.  Looking at pictures, seeing what looks like creative and fresh pairings.  Kei Sushi did a great job. Had the standard sushi offerings and the creative unique ones as well.  Fish was fresh.  Price was right.  All you can eat was offered.  Sushi bar area was large as well as dining room table area.  Overall we had a great time. Service was on par with Reno.

Great sushi find in New Orleans. Fresh, tasty dishes and super friendly owners. Rainbow roll and cucumber salad delicious!  Don't be fooled by the food court location, very good quality fish. Highly recommend.
We were in town for the weekend and stopped by. We had the spicy pork tamales which were great and the fish tamales which were ok .  Good service but they need more space.

We really loved Raffy as our sushi chef. He listened to what we liked and came up with some beautiful and yummy rolls. There was a filet mignon roll that was excellent too. The all you can eat sushi is a great way to try lots of variety. Thanks for all the fresh ginger Raffy!

Some of the best sushi I have had in America. Very authentic except for specialty rolls, which were great, but are very westernized. The fish is very fresh, preparation and presentation were picture perfect. Special appetizer was whole fish (type of yellowtail, aji) served whole and sliced perfectly and served with special sauce and fresh wasabi. The soy sauce and Ginger dressing are made in house and you can taste the difference!
Not cheap but well worth it!
The owner and staff are very friendly. Bring your own sake or wine.

Great value. We love Sushi Teri downtown for family dinner nights with our teenage daughters.  I love the Mike 2 roll that is an incredible value considering the generous amount of fresh sashimi grade fish in it.  We also love their Tempura Udon.  My younger daughter likes to get the kids meal with chicken terrify and rice and salad.   We have always had a great service.  The people are friendly and helpful. I think the best sushi value in town!

The sushi was great but the location is not and the customer service was alright because the waitresses and waiters seem very forced in trying to be nice. I recommend Tokyo sushi. Their sushi is better and the customer service is better too.
What's not to like? Authentic Italian food at dirt cheap prices. The canolis are out of this world!

Classic Italian food in an authentic, old-school restaurant setting.  We had great appetizers, terrific pasta and a great fillet special. The walls and decor in this place are just dripping with originality and history.  Cute little bar in the back as well.  If you're expecting white gloves, Zagat-rated cuisine, don't bother coming.  But if you want a great meal from a true south philly Italian restaurant, check it out.

business_name: Da Sesto Italiano Ristorante e Vino
review_text:
The food was excellent...homemade pasta with authentic Italian bolagnese sauce! The servers and staff were very friendly and attentive. The atmosphere reminded of restaurants we've been to in Italy. 

I love the place so much we're going back with some friends this weekend.....

So we were back again this weekend and got great food and superb service from our waitress Salvatrese. She was an excellent server....she explained all the specials, was very friendly and brought our food out in a timely but unrushed fashion. This will now be our go to Italian restaurant. And we will always request Sal !!

Mad "Props" to Mad Mario's!

The hot sandwiches are amazing!! I've had the Chicken Parmigiana, the Italian and the Meatball. All were great, hot, and tasty!
The sides are very good as well. I recommend the House Pasta salad and the Pesto Pasta salad!
The service was good and we were lucky that we arrived before the lunch rush as it filled up quickly about 10 minutes after we sat down. Seating can get limited around 12 noon and a good idea might be some patio seating as the weather gets warmer.
Try it!!!

If you are looking for authentic Italian food, this is a great choice. The pasta is all home made and the prices are reasonable. I had the chicken parmigiana and it was fantastic, a TON of food. They had live music playing when we were there which was a nice touch.  We will be back!

This is our favorite Restaurant in Tucson. My wife and I have been coming here for years. Great authentic Italian food served by a true Italian Family.  They are so kind and always greet us with a smile and hug every time we dine there.  Want to impress someone? Take them here

We were excited to try the "Authentic Italian Menu," but we were mislead by some of the menu descriptions.  Gnocchi was listed under the Seafood portion of the menu, supposedly including shrimp.  Our dish came out and the shrimps were actually the tiny salad shrimps you would find at Sam's Club, and the shrimps weren't even cleaned/deveined.  We had to scour for the shrimp in the pool of cold gnocchi since there were so few--this is barely considered seafood.  Carbonara dish was bland but nothing a little bit of salt and pepper couldn't fix.  Service was okay and the owner (?) did make an effort for serve us quickly with the restaurant taking care of two "large" tables.  Bread was offered towards the middle of our meal and not in the beginning as most restaurants have the courtesy of doing. A 6" baguette and small packages of butter is not necessarily what I would consider authentic Italian.

I was visiting the area and wanted Italian food for lunch. I came here on recommendation of two locals. I don't know what authentic Italian food are, but I have been to many Italian restaurants. This restaurant is pretty good! I ordered chicken alfredo, and I have to say it was the best I've had. I would like to try this place again for dinner. The service was good.

hey all~ i tried Alfredo's Italian Pizza Kitchen yesterday with my girls. It used to be Tivoli, which we loved, and then was something else we didn't like,~ HOWEVER, NOW it is Alfredo's and it is fabulous!!! They remodeled the whole restaurant and it is beautifully done. The food was authentic Italian and being Italian I am VERY picky! I had the Eggplant Parm and a slice of Pizza and Domenica had the wings which she said were perfection. Giovanna got Spaghetti with Marinara.
~ It is tucked away in the corner of Rt.926 and Route 202. 
Where the Walgreens is.
~You will not be disappointed if you go there. :)
Very good authentic Italian!  Didn't know reservations were needed but they still let us in!  Service was great and they made our daughter feel special!

This place is a cool, authentic Italian desert show (and possibly French???). They only serve cannolis is the native Italian style and offer two sizes, mini and regular. They have fresh ground espressos, gelato, and much more. My only critiques would be the prices, $18 for 6 mini cannolis or $9 for a specialty one. The coffee and gelato is similarly expensive but not as ridiculous! The employees/owner seem very nice and caring, and even gave us some extra chocolates to try! Overall, authentic spot but kind of touristy....

I brought a group of 4 to Zia's for some amazing Italian food. They did not dissapoint. Everything was amazing. I suggest this place for anyone that wants to give their guests the Best that St. Louis has to offer. The bread, salad and pastas were great. I'd suggets everyone getting a salad, appetizer and splitting the pasta between two people.

Don't be put off by the strip mall location. This a good pasta restaurant and they know what they're doing.  The minestrone was rich and the veggies firm.  Bolognese pasta with farfalle was very meaty and perfectly seasoned.  The pasta was al dente. And the cheese was Romano - not the ubiquitous Kraft Parmesan and most low-end Italian Restaurants

Old School Italian dining at it's best. The food was great the service was on point. The atmosphere was old-school Sopranos. The oysters and spaghetti was phenomenal. My wife's duck pasta was awesome as well. 
Old school Italian done well!
Not too great! The pasta was very oily/ sticky and I wouldn't say it's authentic Italian.
One of the best places in conshy!! Great little Italian spot! Every pasta dish is top notch!!

Extremely bland and ordinary, and slow. Crust was preformed frozen, with gummy mozzarella and the Parmesan was the stale and tasteless packaged variety in shakers. Tomato sauce was nearly without tomato flavor. Really only deserves 1/4 star but yelp doesn't give that option. Sad pizza in a city famous for its food.
Absolutely tasteless burger. Was it even real beef? Yuk! An absolute waste of my money.

1.5 stars. To sum up, the food "looks" the part but was fairly tasteless. 

The Black Bean Soup was the favorite part of my meal. The nut burger I had was really bland and the side of pasta salad (that comes with the burger) was also a miss

My husband enjoyed his potato taco but all the trimmings (beans, rice, etc.) were just OK.

My kids were smitten by the teppanyaki chef's performance. For me, that was the highlight. I remember as a child in the early 70's being transported when we went to Benihana's in my hometown. Tonight's dinner experience was homogenous and bland. It felt very much like any other chain restaurant. The server who took our order wasn't able to answer our question, "what is agedashi tofu?" or how is tataki tuna prepared? The answers were vague. The restroom was sloppy. No tp in one, and paper towels strewn about; soap dripping onto the counter; lousy pop-music playing too loud....you get the picture. The food was bland, bland, bland. The tataki (seared) tuna was tasteless. The salad was drowned in dressing. The hibiscus iced tea was way-over sweetened. The green iced tea was also too sweet. Others in my party of 6 were similarly disappointed. It was inelegant and very disappointing as a dining experience. It was void of international flavor. I just took a Zantac for my very unhappy belly.

Friends wanted to go to Wildflower for dinner.  We ordered the half chicken.  It was service raw and returned.  They then service chicken so overcooked that it was a rubber chicken.  House salad was bland and small.  Fried shrimp and vegetables were tasteless.  Other main courses were average.  To compensate for the chicken, the manager considerately gave us free dissert, donuts and toppings.  The donuts did not even remotely taste like donuts, just dough.
I think that the restaurant is relatively pricey for Tucson and is very pretentious.  Not worth the money.

If I could give zero stars I would. Horrible food. Nacho fries were raw and the manager refused to make it right. Beans and rice are tasteless and enchiladas were nasty. Will never go back here. I don't know how they are in business serving this tasteless and overpriced food.
Drop "Pizza" from the name and just call this place "Elizabeth's" as the pies were cold, bland, and tasteless. You will be better off having an Ellios pizza topped with an artichoke.

Cold, tasteless food. My wife and I went here after seeing the amazing reviews, but after trying it, I don't understand why. 

I got the meat sampler:
- tri-tip: cold and there's no taste. We tried adding salt & pepper, but that meat was helpless. 
- ribs: edible but cold.
- pulled pork: cold & tasteless. 

Even the BBQ sauces were awful! 

The only good thing about the restaurant is the friendly staff. 

I rarely turn away food, but I left with an empty stomach.

My wife and I were looking forward to brunch. It was our first visit.
What a disappointment!
After 20 minutes our order had still not appeared. When we said we were leaving it suddenly arrived.
The food itself was not appealing at all. My dish was piled with some sort of potatoes, a sausage patty, scrambled eggs and burnt toast all squeezed together on a plate that was not quite large enough to hold it all. Not a very appetizing picture. 
My wife had some sort of a bland, tasteless, peanut butter and jelly concoction that came nowhere near the breathless description on the menu.
All in all there are too many good restaurants in Tucson that serve excellent brunches and breakfasts for one to patronize this one.

Horrendous quality food! We all arrived starving and We all love Greek food but have never been so disappointed with a dinner--Dry, bland and tasteless food--as if the chef completely does not care. Completely inedible!
good place for drinks and basic apps...food was bland and not very fresh...bland. The McDonalds of Mexican food.

This was far from the best Thai food I've ever had. The Coconut Chicken Soup was bland. Pad Thai, the most basic dish, was tasteless as if it had been sitting around for days. Worst of all was the service. Our server was a grouchy woman who couldn't manage a smile and managed to spill hot tea on me. With all the great Thai restaurants in University City - I can't imagine how this one exists.

Went here for my fiance's birthday at his request. The drinks were great the service was not. Our female server seemed less than enthused to be serving us even though we were one of the few tables in the place.

With the amazing reviews that this place received and was listed as a best new restaurant my expectations were high but what I received was subpar. The appetizers were great but my meal was less than great. Bland and tasteless is one way to describe it.

 My fiance and my drinks sat empty and was never asked if we wanted another drink. The bottle of water we received for the table was also lukewarm and far from thirst quenching.

If you are looking for artisan cocktails come here. There is better food and better service in other places around New Orleans.
The pork was tough and everything else was tasteless. The margaritas were boring too. This is one big MEH.
Food delivery had weird inedible pieces (soup dumplings) and wasn't tasty. The wonton soup was tasteless
Poor excuse for Mexican food, but then again so is every Taco Bell. Same tasteless food Texas to PA.

Went for Saturday "Date Night" supper that is offered once or twice a month in summer. Place is very comfortable and the help is friendly and attentive. Food was great-  They have a fixed price menu on Date Night. $ 49 per couple for one of 5 entrée choices (beef, fish, pork, chicken or shrimp) with soup or salad and desert. Exceeded our expectation and we'll definitely do it again

Love this local gem! I've never had a less than stellar meal here. Love the truffle ravioli, bacon wrapped dates, bay scallops, bruschetta..honestly it's all fantastic! A fun place for a romantic date or night out with the girls. Probably not as kid-friendly, but perfect for an intimate adult night out.

I'm sure our server was friendly, but I couldn't hear him enough to be sure. It's a very noisy place to eat. I took my girlfriend here on a Saturday night. The place was busy, which is expected on a weekend night, but overly crowded. The tables are crammed together. I'm sure to get as many people seated as possible, but it totally eliminate the romantic atmosphere expected of a classy restaurant. The food was appealing and delicious, which is the only reason I gave this place 2 stars instead of 1. On date night, it's more than just about the food, it's about the experience. They failed to deliver on that notion. We probably won't be back.
Awesome spot.  Whether you're ducking in for a drink when you get off the train or going out for date night, you can't go wrong.  Food is great, service is friendly, prices are fair.  Can't go wrong.

I chose this spot for my wife and my "final" date night since she's 8 months pregnant. We arrived just after opening and although we didn't have a reservation, the staff were very inviting and made sure to seat us. The food was amazing, our server was kind and pleasant, and the owner came over to check in on us. We will be back for our next date night whenever they may be!

Ordered "The All American Burger" w/ Macaroni & Chs and "The Meats" Pizza - both were absolutely delicious! Hands Down the BEST Macaroni & Chs you'll ever eat! Friendly service, good music and a fun atmosphere for a date night in Nashville!!

Came here for a date night with friends and it was great. The food was amazing. We had the wings and monkey fingers. They have a huge drink selection and most of them are very tasty. The only reason why I didn't give this place 5 stars is because the waitress was fairly new and couldn't answer most of the questions we had about food and drinks. She was very nice but just clueless about her products. I would recommend coming here if you're looking for a fun night with friends or family but definitely not a romantic setting for date night. It can get pretty loud inside at night.
Top notch. The food, staff, and atmosphere were all excellent. great place for a date night.
Went here on a date night with my hubby and definitely recommend! Some of the most delicious Italian food I've ever had! Will be back!

Amazing food, amazing drinks , amazing atmosphere!! Have been there many times, once was for date night, girls night and then night one of my bachelorette. Date night was intimate( they sit you in the back). Girls night we sat at the bar and it was fun. The best was the dinner for my bachelorette. We had a group of 10 girls and they were so accommodating! It was so much fun! It's a great place for couples & groups. The food is outstanding & if you like dirty martinis then you need to try this place!!!!

I started coming here 5 years ago as soon as I moved into the neighborhood . This place is yummy. The mushroom soup & ahi tuna apps are delicious.  I'm a big fan of the petit filet & the salmon. The staff is  so sweet & so hilarious. Very romantic. Perfect for a first date.

Great atmosphere with amazing fresh food. Service was nice but had to wait (understandable because it was busy). Was able to get a table fast on a busy nice. Upstairs offers a great view for date night.

Cute, romantic ambiance! Very small restaurant and they do not take reservations.  Menu is updated for what's in season. They have a nice "community bar" where you can wait and a server will come get a drink order from there which is a nice change from gathering around a crowded bar while waiting. Food was absolutely delicious. This is a great date night- be prepared to spend some $$$ when you come here.
Becoming a usual date night for my husband and I. Great customer service, very friendly, get seated pretty quickly and amazing Tacos!!
The best local sushi around for the price!  Quick service, free green tea with lunch, great food.   Never had a bad meal!   Up to date atmosphere, great for family meal or date night!

Came here for team dinner, and was pleasantly surprised. I had the beef tartare, it was pretty good with truffle oil and the greens. Then the crab cake was tasty too. Really lumps of crabs in there, def one of the better ones I've had. The restaurant is kinda noisy though, and the restrooms are outside the restaurant in the office building.

Everything about this restaurant was amazing: the servers were friendly, the LA galbi was to DIE for, and the atmosphere was nice: not super quiet but not loud and noisy either. The only possible drawback I would have would be the price point, its a little pricey for some, however, I would definitely recommend!!

I'm sure our server was friendly, but I couldn't hear him enough to be sure. It's a very noisy place to eat. I took my girlfriend here on a Saturday night. The place was busy, which is expected on a weekend night, but overly crowded. The tables are crammed together. I'm sure to get as many people seated as possible, but it totally eliminate the romantic atmosphere expected of a classy restaurant. The food was appealing and delicious, which is the only reason I gave this place 2 stars instead of 1. On date night, it's more than just about the food, it's about the experience. They failed to deliver on that notion. We probably won't be back.
Locals place. Have been there multiple times. Always excellent food. Can be a little bit noisy though.
Beautiful building, great restoration.  Craft cocktails.  Food good, but will wait to try again before chiming in.  Very, very noisy if small rooms are full.

We don't get it.  The place is noisy and crowded.  The service is rushed and uncoordinated.  For example, our second course arrived before we finished our first course.  And, each platter of food was served with so many vegetables, you could barely find what you thought you had ordered.  We could hardly find the hangar steak underneath the pile of broccoli it was buried underneath.  And the trout, while good, came with enough cauliflower to serve a family of six.   If you enjoy what look like huge servings (mostly vegetables) of  overly seasoned food, perhaps you'll go for this place.  But, if you want imaginative cuisine in a more refined setting, I suggest you stay away.
Very crowded on Sunday - waited 2o minutes -- good but not great - over priced - noisy. decent service. Sweet potatoe hash browns good - pancakes ok .

Had breakfast there this morning.  My first visit.  Food was good, but a couple issues.  First, the place is very noisy due to the concrete floors and the metal ceiling.  Can barely hear yourself talk.  It was crowded, but way too noisy.  Also, the ceiling air duct was blowing directly onto our table which may it very cold and uncomfortable.  I did advise the owner he needs to adjust the air vent.  Service and food were fine, but the noise about gave me a headache.

Went before going to see philly pops. Had shrimp cocktail which is shrimp cocktail nothing diffrent. Friend had the wedge that was very good. Had the bone porter house medium. Came out little rare. It.was still tasty, friend had Brazilian lobster, 108 bucks lol. It was a 20 Oz nice size but to me lobster is lobster. Had the king crab gnocchi which ok, potatoes au gratin was good asparagus was fresh. 
Service was a little slow, but it was really crowded. I sort of like the capital grill better still. I most likely would not go out of my way to come back here.

It was crazy noisy as well
Great food and service, a little too many kids though. It's a great local bar/restaurant but not for families with noisy little ones.

I popped over for Happy Hour after work. I had an "Aviator," which involved Gin and some kind of violet liquor. It was delicious. I also had these little shrimp and pork things which were delicious. It wasn't noisy or crowded and the bartender was very nice.

The appeal of this place is that it is right on the beach, convenient for getting a margarita or a bite while in your swimsuit. Place is pretty noisy and crowded. Food is the standard Frenchy offerings, which are pretty good, but the overall experience is better at the Original Frenchy's

I LOVE Be Well. They are what you think of when you think of a quaint coffee shop. They have tons of seating and couches for coffee drinkers or college students studying. 

Paninis are amazing, as well as their gluten free treats. I've yet to try their smoothies, but hear good things.

It can get a bit noisy when it's crowded: I guess it's not a place where people know to stay quiet. Big groups don't keep their voices down.

Employees are sweet and friendly, and help you when you're not sure what you want.
Besides being noisy the service is perfect and the food is awesome!!!!!!!! I would highly recommend this place if you are in a mood for genuine Hispanic food.

This restaurant had just opened the week before and we decided to give it a try. The interior decor was very attractive and most of the seating was in booths. We both had hibachi style meals and were impressed with the taste and quantity. From soup to salad to entrees, everything was great. We are pleased to have a new Japanese restaurant so close to home!

Great place with great drinks! Came here for cocktails after dinner with a group of six. You enter thru an alley into a Super cool space with great decor and speakeasy vibe. I really loved the old movies that were being projected on the exposed brick walls. They also have a nice outdoor seating area for hanging out.

Having just moved to this neighborhood I was excited to try this adorable, ADORABLE little spot. It didn't hurt that they have some killer happy hour specials. Buck-a-shuck? Yes, please!

I was charmed by the exterior but even more so by the interior. The lounge area contains lots of cozy seating with a bohemian ambiance and eclectic decor. The service was friendly and as attentive as could be. She made sure our glasses were never empty and plates were always full. I also have a lot of respect for a server that gives me the last call for happy hour. I'll keep drinking beyond that but I  like to save a buck as much as the next person.

Speaking of "bucks"... buck-a-shuck clams and oysters and cocktail shrimp. Lots of other options for under $5. I highly recommend the roasted brussels and the cauliflower. Also $5 - BUBBLES (and martinis and red/white wine and maybe beer?) and $9 specialty cocktails. 

My only complaint was that my shrimp were a little chewy/overcooked. Everything else was glorious. I look forward to coming back!

The positives are that this is a very cool space with great decor and a nice bar. I can't give it a higher rating because while the food is well prepared and tasty, the Tapas size servings and high drink prices are tough to take. I'm not a fan of having to grab a snack from the frig after eating out!

Let's put it this way they had a vegan option . It was decent , but when i think cheese steak,  i think greasy goodness , which this lacked. It is a hipster version of cheese steak. Serivce great, decor retro .... amazing pickles!!!!

Urban Grub, you get all the stars. Great service, great decor, wonderful service...and the food WAS AMAZING!!!! My husband said this was the best pork chop he ever had! And he said it was one of his top 5 meals ever. That's a huge compliment! We've had a lot of great meals! I had the coal-roasted beet salad and the salmon. Yum! Oh, and the andouille!?! So wonderful!!! If we lived in Nashville, we would definitely be going back often.
The steak is always the best. Very flavorful and juicy. Slightly pricey, but the flavor is great. Decor is very outdated country. Service was good, arrived around 8pm and seated promptly.

2 stars for the decor. 0 stars for everything else.

What a disappointment. This place gets great reviews so we decided to try it. Well, I guess our terrible service started from the minute i ordered a water. I won't go into great detail and make this a 6 page review so I'll just bullet point the experience.

- Bland chicken pad thai with way too many noodles and too few veggies/chicken
- Eggrolls were pretty good
- Men's restroom filthy - see picture 
- Worst service from our server/waitress
- Tiny two top table was very cramped in the corner
- Beer/liquor prices are crazy. $4 for Miller Lite. $5 for imports. 
- Side order of curry $5. Ridiculous. (Free at better Thai places in the area)
- Nice interior decor. Kind of Epcot-ish

We won't be back because there are so many other/better Thai places in the area and we just assume this place gets rave reviews based solely on the interior decor.
Great drink selection, fair prices, cool outdoor seating area. I would definitely stop back. The decor and atmosphere are cozy and the staff are friendly.

Wife and I had such a great experience here we came back twice.  Truly excellent fish and seafood.  Beautiful interior and great service.  About the service...  We had such good service the first time we came that we asked for the same server the next night.  He took absolutely AMAZING care of us and went way overboard making us feel special.  The best part of that was that management obviously supports empowering servers to do this.

Really wonderful place for high quality food and service.

Today was my first experience coming to this restraunt, I had a great experience.    When you first walk in, it gives you a cozy feeling.   The staff are welcoming you when you first walk in and offering to help you.   

The decor is beautiful and more importantly, the food.  

The food was excellent and very fresh.    The prices are not bad.    If your trying to bring the family out for breakfast, this is the place to be.

My experience at The District Tap was pretty enjoyable. The food was delicious and they have a nice selection of beer. I really liked the atmosphere (fairly quiet, comfy booths, cozy decor, fire place, big screen TVs, etc). The service was timely and friendly. My only complaint is that it is slightly more expensive than similar places.

It's always nice to have a cup of coffee in the morning to start your day and we were led to this adorable coffee shop. They had a nice patio and a very cozy and decorative interior.
One of my biggest pet peeves is when something I order is not available. My bf and I both wanted the vanilla coffee and to our pleasant surprise, they were already out of that on a Sunday morning. :( sigh so we ended up getting the regular brew which was pretty good black until I added some milk.

We like Asihi for lunch buffet.  The interior is pleasant and cozy and the staff is friendly.  The price is great for lunch but it gets too high for dinner in my opinion!  Like the fact that they have a basic sushi selection and several interesting entrees on the buffet.  It's an affordable place for the family or a quick lunch!

I always love going to a nice place to eat where the owners love for food and his entrepreneurship shows. Food was amazing and so was the service. Nothing fancy but quiet, family friendly, great decor and fast service in a non fast food setting. I did the spicy spaghetti with shrimp and it was great. My 5 year old ate every bite of his and his sisters. If your debating going here, just do it! You won't be sorry. 
Thank you for a great dinner!
Came here with a friend on Sunday for lunch. The atmosphere was very nice, cute interior! Great service, large portions. The food was delicious, spiced just right. Very enjoyable experience.

We stopped by for drinks and dessert, and we couldn't have been more impressed! We ordered slices of strawberry cheesecake, and we ordered two very stiff drinks from the bar. 

The atmosphere is very dimmed and relaxed. Service is great, and it is very clean. The tv always had a game of golf going, and the interior decor of the restaurant was golf themed. 

The menu was pricey, but definitely worth it.

Cozy & eclectic interior. Great food! We had the queso fundido, the veggie burrito, and carnitas. It was too much to finish. We took home leftovers. The place was packed on a Tuesday night. Our server was great and the margaritas were strong.

Reservations were made online and when we arrived we were told that it would be a few minutes.  We waited at the bar for 10 minutes... because the place was so packed with eager diners?  Absolutely not... it was dead as a morgue.  

Finally seated, we ordered the chilled shrimp, scallops, and the crab cake.  The shrimp was good, nothing toe curling but not a bad choice for an app.  The crab cake was actually the best that I've had in Philadelphia so far... so much delicious crab meat.  The scallops were a let down because of the texture and lack of flavor.

Overall, not a bad experience but I think it suffered from that "okay food, not worth your money, overpriced menu" syndrome.
Not worth the overpriced burrito.. The meat is terrible. Also you have to pay extra for half the veggies that normal burrito places that are cheaper and better give you for free! Not a fan!!!

Beautiful location but that's about it.
We couldn't sit outside on the patio because supposedly they didn't have any staff for it because it was lunch time however there were people sitting outside being served. Their bar menu was only available at 3 pm which was very small and overpriced. $7 for plain edamame and $18 for a small crab cake. It took almost 20 minutes to get our food and the place was almost empty. The servers were slow and the food itself was just okay not worth the money.

Not worth the money.   The food didn't have much flavor and the textures weren't very good (the fish were chewy and so were the crawfish beignets).  If it was $15 I might give it three stars but for $30/entree I expected a lot more than this.
So overrated. The food is overpriced and the hoagies are not that great.  Before it was more authentic had a very homey feeling now they are so rude won't be spending my money here again.

No doubt the best Chinese cuisine close to campus. All noodles are distinct with their broth and style, and the Chongqing Spicy Chicken is a must get. Portions are huge and definitely worth the money.
Boats and bridges are all very good. Really like the California pizza also. Restaurant is nice. Service is always really good. Overpriced but worth it.

business_name: The Hungry Fox Restaurant & Country Store
review_text: Had a coupon so tried the place out. Not worth any amount of money. The omelet was so overdone the eggs were brown all the way through. Any good kitchen wouldn't have let that out... service was sluggish. Avoid.
Absolutely rude service. Substandard food. Not worth the time or money. Go to McDonalds or Cookout across the street.

OK, it's good, but it is also horrendously overpriced.  Call me crazy but $24 for a 3 topping large pizza is insanely overpriced and even as good as it was, I wouldn't go back, it's simply not worth the money--even Dewey's Pizza is a lot less and Dewey's is a bit on the pricy side.  We went because we were entertaining an out of town guest and we had heard for a long time how good Pi is--which is true, it is good--but when I saw what they were charging for pizza, I choked on my overpriced beer.  If we hadn't had a guest with us, we would have left, it was that ridiculously expensive.  If money is no object, enjoy, but if you want value for your hard earned money, go somewhere else because the sticker shock may kill you.

This isn't a place that we will ever return to.  We ordered a few drinks and burgers. Drinks were weak and $$$.  Burgers were good but not worth the money that is charged.  The employees are not interactive. It was average food at best.
A very nice place for dinner with friends, co-workers or SO.  Well worth the money. Don't be be fooled by the size of the restaurant...great service.

The service was great.  Our sever was very knowledgable and friendly.  I thought the meal was overpriced..  Although very good I have had equally good meals at much less expensive steak houses.  I also never had an $8.50 backed potato or $8.50 spinach before.  It was a good meal but not worth the money they charged.  I will not return.
The food comes in really strange plates lol. The food is pretty okay. Nothing special. I can make this at home lol. Don't waste your money because it's deff overpriced

This crepe cake has great depth of flavour which makes it a complete worth of money. Just a tad of sweetness that helps all other flavours to come out beautifully. The mangoes are also kept in balance with the size of the cake. A well crafted dessert.
Decent food. Got the stuffed shrimp. Just didn't think it was worth the money. But not like it was bad food or service.
Food was great! Presentation really nice! Friendly staff too. I am not gluten free but my daughter is, bought one of each of the breads to bring home, the breads were well worth the money spent.
Baja style eats in Reno? Excellent. Great prices, more food than i could eat in one sitting. Clean restaurant with ample seating and a huge menu. Very good choice.
Cheap eats at best nothing to rave about
Great food and service. Solid beer menu. Lunch special with half salad and pizza is a great value!

Good stuff and cheap. Was just here Sunday the 20th of Dec. i came before 6 pm and there was still happy hour so got a really good cocktail - bootlegger. Also had 2 starters for $6 each which were delish- guacamole and the maui flat.
For entree i had the meatloaf which is known to be their best dish- it was very good (for meatloaf lovers).
Good vibes, TV on the bar, great friendly service and best value for money around Gulch

business_name: Woksabi Now Known as Chow's Chinese Restaurant
review_text: Went back recently with my wife for Sushi...was blown away by the presentation and quality of the sushi rolls.  Updating my review to 4 stars.  Great value.
Food is delicious and a great value!  I wish it was closer so I could get dinner from here too!

Cafe de monde is a mandatory visit when you come to New Orleans. The beignets are fresh and hot and chewy, surprisingly not that greasy, although too much powder sugar to my liking. They do pair up nicely with a cup of strong hockey coffee. Cheap eats, not the healthiest option, but definitely a great treat. Try to come during the week...the lineups on the weekends are ridiculous.
Excellent, efficient service--accurate order and delicious food ordered through website!  Great value, too!
Best sushi place in the area -- fresh, and new takes on it. They offer Korean, Japanese, and Thai. All of it is good. The lunch is a great value.

As one of the very talented singers stated as some folks left the joint "don't leave, they don't understand you out there, we understand you in here." She couldn't have been more right. You will not be disappointed by this classic honky tonk! Cheap drinks & eats (and delicious!). The live music could not have been better or more authentic Nashville. My husband and I kept coming back for more and stayed as long as we could. It was a knee slapping good time!
Probably the best Asian market in del co. The food court is great for cheap quick eats.

This place has always been amazing. My brother he gets the barbecue beef and I get the fried shrimp poboys.  The onion rings are a phenomenal value. Awesome taste and a lot of food for a cheap price. Customer service has always been spot on and this place is clean.

Back for more, I found that Cafe Hey has it down for consistent work. Nice breakfast burrito was fresh and flavors were nice together and yet identifiable. Nice coffee, tasty Cuba toast. I go in here to lay back and unwind. Go here for good food, intentionally slow service, (meant as a compliment) chilling out, It's not cheap, but a good value. Cafe Hey does a good job of being what they want to be. Kudos!

You cant go too wrong with meat + rice + pepper sauce.  For whatever reason putting a fried egg on this combo makes it awesome.  Had the bim bop and steak bowl.. Get the bim bop korean salad version its cheaper w more veggies. Good cheap eats!
I've been here a few times. Always excellent service, very cool people. Food is great and the value for what you pay is excellent. I'm definitely a return customer.
I go here often.Its great value and authentic.I appreciate the fast ordering and very quick delivery...How do they do hatband still deliver good insistently???

Great value. We love Sushi Teri downtown for family dinner nights with our teenage daughters.  I love the Mike 2 roll that is an incredible value considering the generous amount of fresh sashimi grade fish in it.  We also love their Tempura Udon.  My younger daughter likes to get the kids meal with chicken terrify and rice and salad.   We have always had a great service.  The people are friendly and helpful. I think the best sushi value in town!

I go here every year it is the perfect vacation for a week or a couple of nights but watch out for the pricing it is a little expensive but it is all worth it especially with the sound waves package which is their amazing waterpark

Deeeeeeeee-licious! Enjoyed to steak tacos, that was down right yummy! They do except credit here, if your purchase is at least $8.00. If not be sure to carry cash. It's worth every penny spent! Can't wait to go back..gotta craving!
Great food and service!  It is expensive but worth it! It can get loud on the bar side but the experience of tasting their steaks is worth any shortcomings this place might have!
It's worth every penny! The fact that you can get a beer or margarita and not wait for a waitress to seat you is the best.
The food here is sooo good! Their Cuban fries are a must and the pork tacos are incredible! It's a little pricey but it's worth every penny!

When it's time for a special meal...Mesa Verde! Truly BEAUTIFUL food, things I usually don't eat, I LOVE there. Great service, nice wine list and for goodness sake, save room for dessert. A little pricey for healthy foods, but worth every penny.

I had the Market Salad at the bar; they held the red onions and suggested with shrimp: Perfect. Dressed with a very nice lemon vinaigrette that was also perfect. Loads of heirloom cherry tomatoes, and delicious. An Arnold Palmer and delicious bread capped a spot-on lunch that kept me going, on my way flying out of Tucson. Will be back. Worth every penny.

A little pricey, but worth every penny.  Whether your looking for a place for a special celebration or just a date night you won't go wrong with the chophouse.  Their prime rib is outstanding and seafood is cooked to perfection.  The wait staff is super knowledgeable and courteous which makes the evening a real treat.
Very great plates!! Fresh and hot even if you take it to go! I got the falafel plate and the falafel was HUGE!! Worth every penny! Was stuffed and could barely finish the plate! Will return soon.

Amazing food! tofu soups are delicious:) 
Highly recommend trying this restaurant. Galbi is what I always get with my tofu, very filling and worth every penny

The only place in Nashville that does tacos right. $3 a pop, and worth every penny. Avoid the BNA hats and pumpkin spice lattes in 12th South eating $6 tacos from Bartaco, and just go to Mas Tacos - you won't regret it.
Large sake bombs are the best!! It was definitely worth every penny! The salmon tempura rolls are the best.
Expensive but worth it! I had the sweet potato roll, diamond roll and Tiger roll, don't have a single complaint about any of them! They were plated beautifully and the taste was fresh and amazing.

Review is for drinks, ambiance and crowd... can't comment on the food.  I've noticed there's a lot of negative reviews for the food, but this place is so OBVIOUSLY NOT the kind of place you go for food.  This is a shoulder to shoulder, get your drink on kind of place.   It's a regular folk, 20 to 30-something kinda joint and not one of those poshy upscale places that are so popular these days.  Good strong drinks, fairly priced, bathroom not too disgusting.  A-OK.

I wish that I could give this place a better rating. Burgers are good...food is good but the place is disgusting! The old owners would of never allowed this place to look like this. It's just not the food its the dinning experience...which is absolutely none...its dirty and the bathroom is gross. Not sure what happened but since it changed awhile ago its gone down hill and its ashame because I like a good burger and this is or was the place to eat not anymore

Most of the time this place ranks a 5. Excellent burgers, fish and chips, crab fontina dip. Lately I've been a little disappointed with service (food, not servers!) and conditions in bathroom, lack of soap, dirty, smelly. Step up your game City Works!!
Service was good. Bloody Mary was good. Food was terrible! and the place is dirty, even the menus were dirty. Even the salt shaker was dirty. Food was below Ruby Tuesday's / Applebees.

If I could give this place less than one star, I would. I came in to a messy restaurant (every table was dirty) and am told that I will be sat once my server, Amber, is done smoking a cigarette. Once we are sat, my friend and I try to help bus some of the tables because it is disgusting. We then get yelled at by Amber so we stop. Amber cussed several tables out and made an uncomfortable atmosphere. It took us 15 minutes to get cashed out. All the while, there were only 4 sat tables in the restaurant. I hope nobody has the misfortune to be served by Amber.
Disgusting. Terrible food, drinks and service. Only place in NOLA I never want to see again.

IF I COULD GIVE THIS A 0 I WOULD!!! the food is very good! But the people are disgusting and disrespectful and not very polite!!! I saw a kid/teen smoking cigarettes!! Disgusting!!! This waitress I don't know her name maybe destiny or Danielle but was completely rude and not very talkitive

Food was ok, service is terrible!!! we order bowl of soup for the table, they bring the soup without small bowls!!! hot tea, they charge $1.50/per person WTH!!! "mini" mayonnaise shrimp got too much breading and little sauce!!! The "reusable"  hot towel  is the same towel they have in the bathroom which is also "reusable" disgusting!!!
The food is disgusting. The steaks have way too much gristle and fat. I do not understand why people claim the food is good.

I love imo's but this was a let down.

The staff was rude, there was a hole in the door, floor and tables were a bit dirty. The bathroom was pretty dirty too.

The food was good and the prices were good. The inside it is cramped but there was a good amount of out door seating.

Disgusting excessively greasy pizza, gross stale old food from a can, cold coffee and no offer for any refill, stingy and pathetic, stale clumped sugar for coffee, feels like a pathetic soup kitchen for poor people, awful slow service, waitress did not supply any napkins to clean mouth, ridiculous high prices for the crap you get, depressing dreary atmosphere, dirty restroom with empty soap dispenser and empty paper towel dispenser.  Everything is old, worn out, dated and dirty.  We were there at 5:30 pm (dinner tme) and we were the only customers in that place which is an indication of the unpopularity of this dump.   Considering the awful food, poor service, high prices, and dingy atmosphere this place will go out of business for sure.  Don't be fooled by this restaurant's Italian name, they don't serve Italian food - they serve disgusting old garbage!  They can attract customers with the Italian name, but they will turn off customers with their horrible food, poor service and high prices.  Don't waste your money and your time in this miserable dark dump.   In my lifetime I have eaten at dozens and dozens of different restaurants and I can honestly say this restaurant is the absolute WORST of the worst and that's not an exaggeration!  I gave this dump one star because there was no option for zero stars.   The accurate and correct rating for this awful, pathetic, crappy dump is five poop symbols!!!

Our server was polite, and that's the only reason we are leaving any stars. 

For starters we were sat a dirty table, and were then moved to a "cleaner table" 

We ordered calamari and it came out tough and without plates to eat off of. When we got our plates they were still wet. From a cleanliness standpoint that's now two strikes. Which had me looking around, and you can tell they don't follow proper sanitation practices. Floors were disgusting.

Salads were disappointing at best, and our main course was just alright. I ordered the chicken Bryan, and it was good. However the broccoli tasted like it was cooked with shell fish "or in a dirty pan, that had previously had shell fish in it."

Overall we will not be returning, and don't advise you to either. 

I will say we have been to the location in Plant City, and overall our experience was night and day. That location is clean, and the food came out as expected.

business_name: Tir Na Nog Kitchen & Irish Pub
review_text: Dirty very Dirty. My friend who works at eco lab told me the kitchen is extremely dirty and that he would never eat here... that was after I went there and had a bad experience. My Berger was disappointing. A coworker of mine worked here in the past and said it was good when it first opened then the owner started to come in asked like a jerk.... not cool

Sushi was delicious! Presentation was great. Staff was quick and friendly. I'm taking away one star bc I got a dirty glass for my soda and half of the lights were out in the bathroom hallway. I am taking away another star bc there was an incessant dinging coming from the front kiosk. It seemed to start periodically and didn't stop until an employee hit a button. And they were real slow to hit that button, so the dinging continued on and off for most of our meal.

Wings were not done. Place was dirty. Bathrooms were disgusting and reeked of bleach. We all have that friend that is a real nice guy but a total dirt bag and there is no way you would eat anything he cooked. Welcome to his restaurant.
Gross. Terrible. Disgusting. Wrong order. It was awful. I wish I could give less then a one star.
disgusting establishment with rude ass bitch men who think islamaphobia is ok. i have never been here and never will. hope you go out of business

The only reason this is getting two stars is because the food tasted good.  The restaurant was seating people right next to each other despite most of the restaurant being empty.  And, the blonde waitress we had at approximately 11:30am today seemed to ascribe to the believe that you can neither catch nor transmit any disease through your nose so when she was wearing a mask it often did not cover her nose.  She took the mask off about 4 feet from our table and proceeded to laugh and talk vigorously with other wait staff right there next to our table (the others were in fact appropriately wearing their masks).  Not long after my visit I became nauseous and later in the day had bowel distress.  We agreed we would never grace that establishment again because it is clear that not all employees cared about the comfort, health and safety of their customers and there was no manager making sure that health protocols were being followed so no telling what was going on in the kitchen.  Now I am going to have to self isolate for two weeks because I have zero confidence that I was not exposed to something just getting something to eat.  Mad.

there is not much that is worth celebrating in my office. incompetent co-workers, violent co-workers (really), and a general lack of work to do means that i need to look forward to something. 

and it is po-boys from adams street. 

an intern in the office and i have created the "po-boy inspection club." the first on our list happened to be adams street, due primarily to the fact that it's only 8 blocks away, but still, it is a choice we have celebrated to this day. the bread was crispy on the outside, but soft in the middle. you get a healthy heap of fried _____ in your sammich, and it's seasoned well too! my only complaint is that the dressing could be more plentiful, but that's why you pick up a couple extra packets of mayo and/or ketchup, and you're good to go...

Stopped by and visited the other day! Staff was so nice and welcoming! I had a pick 2 ultimate topping bowl and it was absolutely amazing! Also all of there health shots were amazing! The recovery shot saved my day!

Giving this 2 stars because I've enjoyed this place in the past. But today I was really let down. Because of the pandemic, they are only doing pick up orders. We called in a large order for dinner, and added on two $50 gift cards to support local business, we waited for 45 minutes. They were not managing the crowd for pickups and had people cramped shoulder to shoulder in front of the hostess stand.... so much for social distancing. I waited outside for the sake of safety until I was told that they couldn't find our order and could put it in now. He offered to give me the gift cards "right away" if I wanted to. I refused, and left. 

Not respecting their health, my health or the health of the community, and just a mess of a pick up situation. 

Get your processes efficient, and up to SB Public Health standard's.

This was my favorite Tex-Mex restaurant, but no more. Since May 2014 has had a long string of horribly failed health inspections  (up to 48 violations ). Food quality has declined significantly,  and no longer clean inside. To be honest, this place was always a dive, but used to be very clean and well maintained. No more. The Mariachis are now playing a very sad song.
Best brunch place for the health conscious who demand yummy food--seriously yummy food. The pancakes are huge.

This Wendy's does not require masks for service inside.   Avoid!   If the don't care about the health of the more senior customers, or the higher risk customers imagine what goes on in the kitchen behind closed doors!.

Indo Puts Health Above Profit
They tried curbside pick-up at the end of March 2020 and were making money.  But after a week, closed the restaurant because the smallness of the kitchen could increase the risk of coronavirus transmission.
Food taste like Absolutely lime shit  rice was not cooked well and shrimp was ass don't know how this restaurant passed inspection and the live band was ass  first and last time I come here .
