Best Thai I have found in the StL area.  The restaurant is clean, staff is friendly, and ingredients always seem fresh.  When you walk to the restroom you can see into the kitchen and I'm always impressed how clean and well run the kitchen appears.  I dine at Pad Thai about twice a month and will continue to visit on a regular basis.
Great food but not 100 percent COVID compliant! Will not be going back! Health department needs to visit!

I order General Tso's Shrimp, which was very Delicious!  Unfortunately, the broccoli and rice that can with the meal was not fresh and tasted as if they were going bad.  Upon further inspection, you could see the parts where the broccoli started to turn. The rice had a weird smell and was slimy. I called the restaurant and they apologized and sent a replacement order (which was awesome!) The delivery was super fast both times...I would have gave a higher rating if it were not for the problem with the spoiled food. However, they did correct the problem, with zero resistance and great customer service.

So we went to the flying pie pizza place tonight on Fairview in Boise and they would not let us eat after they took our order they would not let us eat there because I did not have s mask on  even though I told him I had a health issue and by law they can't ask me my health issue but I even told him my health issue and she said well we're sorry you can't eat here so when I went to get my money back I looked at the bar there's guys in there with no Mask on and not drinking and the lady said well that's different so I would suggest you stay away from the flying pie if you don't have a mask do you have a health issue which is wrong because legally they're not supposed to do that but manager pushed her to weight around and she said no ! Very sad, we ate a different location about a week ago and had no problem, the owner needs to get his story straight! I guess we will need to find a new pizza place!

Marathon is a Community Mainstay for Affordable, Healthy Comfort Food.  Over the years, Marathon on the Square has soundly provided healthy, creative, affordable comfort food to me, my family, friends and other loved ones.  Marathon on the Square is a mainstay in my community because of its extensive hours of operation, healthy menu options that accommodate various dietary needs and wishes, and respectful service.   And yes-Marathon caters and delivers.  Big thumbs up to Marathon.
We've ordered pick up a couple times, everything is always spot on. Thank you for offering so many vegan options! Definitely on our regular rotation now.

My "go to" spot for when my diet has taken a nosedive and I need to get back into the healthy eating world asap. The carrot coco and deep roots juices are full meals in a bottle with 3 pounds of raw fresh pressed fruits and veggies inside. They are as delicious and as satisfying as a juice drink can be. I hadn't been there since they added a made to order menu and was delighted to see it filled with vegan and vegetarian options. Such a rare finding in this town. Now if only finding parking was as easy as choosing what to buy!
Awesome food, great service. Tons of vegan options. Will definitely be back during my stay! Cool merch too, I love the stickers I bought.

One of the best places we ate at in Nashville! It was right around the corner from where we were staying, which was a plus! There were several vegan options. I had the Godzilla smoothie and Your Daily Kimchi bowl. Such delicious flavors, and could be eaten with or without the dressing. Nice atmosphere and decor. Will go back if ever in Nashville again!

Well I guess since I eat here two times a week at least Zoe's is deserving of five stars.

One of very few healthy fresh and good quality options in Newtown Square area if you're looking for something fast and on the go for lunch.

Everything has tons of flavor, and plenty of healthy options on the menu.

Salads that are actually somewhat exciting, Great light sandwiches, and really good entrées.

The entire staff at my workplace is hooked.
Fantastic! Great service, food comes out hot, and everything we had was delicious! We love finding vegan options in Indy!

The vegan options here are great!! I've been twice in one month because the food is that good. A place like this reminds me of the great vegetarian/vegan options I would find when living in Southern California. 

5 stars - Vegan loaded fries. The chili topping and sauce is fantastic! I haven't had chili fries since becoming vegetarian and I finally got to taste it again. This was the best of the whole meal. 

5 stars - Phoney dog. Vegan hot dog topped with vegan chili. This was definitely a meal in itself. Generous helping of vegan chili on the vegan dog. Another winner. 

4.5 stars - Vegan fun guy burger. Two impossible burger patties, vegan cheese, and mushrooms. This one is great. I thought the sweet sauce was a little to sweet. But the burger overall tastes like real meat. 

4 stars - Mozzarella sticks. Crispy exterior and melty interior. I would recommend eating this as soon as it's brought out. Nothing super special about this one. That's because all the other menu items were outstanding. 

Overall, a great meal and a true treat for a vegetarian!

Best Healthy Mexican concept in Tampa! Amazing atmosphere and even better food. Tons of vegan and vegetarian friendly options. The bowls are amazing and house made sauces are to die for, definitely my new favorite place to eat and highly recommend it to anyone, there is something for everyone here

Amazing!!!
So impressed!!! 
What a fantastic menu, from Herbal Alchemy Teas, to a complete vegan brunch menu. I was so thrilled to be able to have an absolutely delicious vegan, and gluten free meal. There are not many restaurants that can accommodate my diet, today I had more options on a brunch menu than I ever have in my life!!!!!! So cool!!! 
Extremely impressed with the ambience, and customer service. 
Can't wait to dine at Mesa Verde again, what a treat!
Really yummy vegan options and really great service. I was in love with the food I got here. Will go back soon!!!!!!

Yummy vegan options!
Fast delivery!!
They give you no issues paying over the phone or at the door. 
No food issues in regards to temperature, quality and amount.

They have really cool vegan specials and menu. I appreciate the variety for vegan options on the menu. The best thing I've eaten there has to be their greens and beans burger with vegan chili open faces. So good!! Their food is very tasty! Their bread rocks. 

I've heard some rumors that their BBQ sauce isn't actually vegan and contains honey. If this is true, they truly need to know that this is not widely recognized as vegan and they should change this or let customers know. I docked a star for the lack of ingredients lists made available to customers and potential lack of transparency. I also docked a little bit because their bean side is not vegan (BBQ without beans is a crime!) and some of their sides are a little on the small side. Still would recommend!!
Cute little spot with great food & great service. Garlic naan was awesome and they had vegan options too.
Great restaurant with plenty of vegan options! Love the roasted veggies
Good vegan soul food. Can't say it's healthy though. Sometimes food can be a bit salty a d lack other seasonings. Other than that, I eat certain options. The cornbread is great!

Great place! 
Ingredients are healthy and well put together! 
You can eat a healthy meal and be satisfied.
Amazing Vegan Gumbo!!! Full of flavor! If you're vegan and looking for tons of options come here!! They have everything from Vegan Apple Sausage to Vegan Pancakes. They also have vegan crab cakes!!

Awesome vegan menu. Would recommend for vegetarians looking for a burger and fries fix. They also have the healthy option of getting a burger without the bun and wrapped in a leaf instead. Good joint that hits the spot.

One of the best places for gluten free pizza. Really delicious!
They take gluten free seriously for those that are Celiac. All gf pizzas are served on plastic trays that have liners stamped "gluten-free".

Two Chicks is one over the very few places I can get a gluten free grilled cheese and not feel disappointed. I mean, having to have gluten free is not a choice for me so that fact I even have the OPTION for gluten free is great. But man, the grilled cheese with whatever gluten free bread they use is just amazing. Ooey gooey goodness. I recently had their breakfast plate (eggs and such) and MAN that was a nice surprise as well! Whenever I'm in Reno and have the time, I try to hit up Two Chicks. Definitely worth it!
Nice and friendly. Cheese fries and gluten free pizza is Awsome. Not a lot of place gave gluten free. Thank you and keep up the good work. See u soon.

Great sandwiches, food is always fresh, and the owner is a great guy who truly cares about the community! They have the best bread of any local place, definitely worth checking out. I don't eat gluten free but a family member that does also raves about their gluten free options as well.
Extremely accommodating and delicious food! Will definitely return. They also have a gluten free menu, and that's greatly appreciated as someone with Celiac disease! Wonderful experience

My mom and I shared a gluten free pancake breakfast here with eggs and sausage.  The mean feed both of us and was really tasty. My mom is a regular here and sleeks very high of it as she is celiac and can not eat gluten.  I would eat there again.

So far this is my favorite restaurant in the Sahuarita/Green Valley area since moving back a couple of months ago.  

I love that they have so many gluten free options on their menu including gluten free French fries on a dedicated frier and gluten free pizza.  But I usually go for the "frustrated Chef" special.  Every time I've ordered it it's been great - and available gluten free.

The food is delicious and the atmosphere is cozy and comfortable.  They have TVs for those who want them but I think you can also chose to sit in areas free from most of the noise.

Stopped for lunch, sat outside on patio.  Creative drinks menu!  Hubby and I created our own burgers which were delightful!  Lots of fries came alongside.  Waitress Pam couldn't have been nicer and was quite attentive.  Lots of gluten free options for my Celiac's hubby.  Try it, you'll love it!

Thanks so much for your gluten free pizza. I know it's kind of a fad diet right now, but not for me. I have to eat gluten free. That's why it's so great to find someone who will sell a great pizza I can eat. 

By the way, your pizza tastes fantastic!

business_name: Dedicated Gluten Free Bakery And Coffee Shop
review_text:
The passion and dedication Rebecca has for her business is incredible. Knowing that she creates pastries, cakes, muffins, cookies, breads, that are gluten, dairy, vegan, and sugar free really helps those people that aren't able to eat those things. My favorite sandwich is The Don, carrot cake is out of this world, snickeredoodle cookies, and the blueberry lemon pound cake are so delicious.

Would give Dedicated Gluten Free 10 stars if able as I'm not gluten free and the food tastes so good!

Had my first visit to VVD today. Tried the maple bacon donut. It was pretty darn good, I must say. And I've been thinking about it all day. I really appreciate that they have gluten free donuts, although I didn't get there in time to try one because they had already sold out. I do believe they only do gluten free on Fridays.

Slow service 
Go elsewhere. Meal so so. Breakfast Specials
No substitute for flour gluten free or dairy free. 
Sugar place
Food was great! Presentation really nice! Friendly staff too. I am not gluten free but my daughter is, bought one of each of the breads to bring home, the breads were well worth the money spent.

Earned a star for their stellar and vast beer selection. Lost four on service. A great beer selection means nothing if you never get served. 

Facts: It was a slow Sunday night, 3 servers standing around, not one came over to our table to take our order. Needless to say, we left. Not at all impressed with this visit to WOB.
Friggin great food and a great beer selection! If ya don't stop in and try it then you lose!
I just couldn't give them 5 stars because it was so hot and uncomfortable the night we were there.  The food was great and the cocktails excellent.  Loved the vibe and decor.
Good food and great cocktails, we sat on their porch so essentially we were outside and socially distant from others. Very nice wait staff
Unreal beer selection. I had delicious scallops. Great atmosphere. I would definitely return.
The tacos were phenomenal. I'm also impressed with their creative cocktails. Their Hefeweizen is a great beer!

The Noble Beer Hall has a great beer selection and an awesome happy hour deal.  Each beer was half price, so we paid small town prices in Nashville.  The waitress was very helpful and attentive.  The Einstok Icelandic beer they have on draft is great.

Kirsten is the best bartender ever! We ate and drank at the bar. My husband loved his rabbit and my seafood cassoulet was awesome! Kirsten was attentive and had great suggestions for drinks and dinner. She mixes great cocktails. We loved our meal and cocktails at Kingfish.
Holy draught selection, Batman! (Ok, I'm dating myself ) Yelp! recommendations reign again! If you like outstanding draught beer, are in Philly... GO! Great service and phenomenal beer choices!!
Greeeeat NOLA Jazz, really nice food (small plates but great selection and variety), nice cocktails, decent beer list.  Very good service. Definitely recommended!!
Great upscale BBQ joint. Loved the atmosphere, food and beer selection. Im really excited to go back!

I really love this place. It's the perfect spot, especially in the summer time, to hang out, get dinner, and chat with girlfriends. The pork buns are amazing. Good drinks, good beer and wine selection and Graffiti Bar in the back has some awesome cocktails. I like the decor inside, but I love this place most for the warm weather season either in the bar out back or sitting outside for dinner. Yum!
Food was good,Service was great and cocktails were just okay but it is a small place with great atmosphere. So many great restaurants in this area I was just a little disappointed but good.
Great spot in Point Breeze / Newbold area.  Friendly and knowledgable staff with a wonderful beer selection.
Amazing all around.head chef is very knowledgeable. great beer selection

We have been to The Couch Tomato a few times in recent months with our 2 year old son. It's delicious food, well crafted, with a solid selection of beer, wine and cocktails (essential elements for the parents of a toddler!). The service is knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive without being overbearing. On our last visit we did the $50 special (app, salad, pizza, dessert, 2 drinks) and it was worth every penny. A great spot on Main Street.

Highly recommend for the specials! Their double cut pork hop is super filling and delicious! They have an awesome selection of sour beer as well! 

Their meat and cheese board is a must as well as their many appetizers! 

Their happy hour could be improved as their selection of cocktails are lacking! 

However all in all totally worth the visit if you are in New Orleans!

good place with a great wine/beer selection, food isnt bad either. 
sunday school is great and happy hour is always fun

Food is great, but NEVER go there for brunch. NEVER. Took us 15 minutes to get our first mimosa, 30 minutes after the 1st to get our 2nd mimosa. Asked for a bottle at our table to make it easier for our waitress, ended up getting charged for endless mimosas and bottles. We fought it. Bad deal. They gave us the bottles off, but we all ended up with 3 "bottomless mimosas." Totally worthless. DO NOT GO FOR BRUNCH! Terrible.

I have been going to a different brunch every month for the past three years and this is BY FAR the best brunch I have found in Nashville.   The food is stellar, and plentiful.  The omelette station and Cuban/Ruben stations made to order just top off the entire experience.  The staff and management seem very knowledgeable, especially our Server, Caitlyn, who made sure our glasses are never empty, and our plates and silver were exchanged the moment our plates were empty, and the Manager, Rich who personally welcomed us and explained the selections on our cheese plate, and made sure it was the best monthly outting we have ever had.
The food is awful and overpriced. Their mimosas come with ice in them. That's a disgrace to serve it like that. They also use $2 sparkling crappy wine for their mimosas.

If you haven't been here before, do yourself a favor and stop in. Even if your not a local, the breakfast omelets are amazing. Everything is well priced, and the staff is super friendly. Mercer Cafe is on my top 5 best brunch spots in all of philly. Oh and they have La Columbe Coffee!
Brunch is amazing. The outdoor seating area is huge and they allow you to bring you pets. Love visiting on a Sunday morning with bottomless mimosas.

Ate Brunch here and the chicken and waffles was incredible. Chicken was crispy and the waffle had a maple bacon flavor, one of the best chicken and waffles I've ever had. Paired with the all you can drink mimosas, bloody Mary's and sangria-you're in for a treat!

KINGFISH

KINGFISH -    337 Chartres St., NOLA - Kingfish is an upscale casual restaurant and cocktail bar in New Orleans' French Quarter that tips its hat to the Huey P. Long Era. The menu embodies new Louisiana cuisine, which creates a unique New Orleans dining experience.

Brunch-      LIBATIONS: Brunch Rose for 3, Mrs. Q had the Bottomless Mimosas (you add your own orange juice). Yes, our server, La Donna was great. She made sure you never ran out of Mimosas.

EATS:  Spinach & Crab Omelet & two had over easy egg w/ bacon, or ham.
Best brunch place for the health conscious who demand yummy food--seriously yummy food. The pancakes are huge.
Love the brunch and all of the staff was great! Very hipster! Enjoyed it! The $5 mimosas were incredible, I just wish I could remember our waiter's name. He was the best!

Boca is a great restaurant to come for brunch, lunch or dinner. Everything is fresh and delicious. Their menu is not the largest, but it definitely has great selection in food. This place is not your typical Outback or Bonefish restaurant. This place is for the foodies out there. Go try them out! Especially for brunch for their unlimited mimosas.
Nice spot especially in the summer. My husband and I love to go here for brunch and order mimosas while people watching. A must go to

Food is not bad , 2 for 1 mimosas .. Which are great! If you go for brunch be ready to wait waaaaaay longer then what they tell you. Happens every time ! Also , heads up.. Man who works the front. Not friendly AT ALL!

The absolute cutest brunch place in Indy!! hands down. The vibes are unmatched, service is quality and the food was delicious!  An abundance of cocktails and bar options. 

The challah French toast is literally the best I've had in a long time! 
And of course the mimosas were perfect. The juice flight is totally worth getting!

Enjoy!
This is such a gem in Florissant. We've been here several times and it never disappoints us. From brunch mimosas to a hearty burger this place is one of my favorites.
Sunday brunch game is so strong. Bottomless mimosas are cheap and delicious, and the food was incredible!! Get the brunch skillet - you will not be disappointed!

This is our second time in four days visiting this restaurant and both times we were not impressed. We had eaten there for both lunch & dinner service and even though not slammed it took FOREVER to be seated, once seated it took FOREVER to be approached for our drink order or even just an introduction.  My coffee cup had something on the inside of the glass and the salmon with mashed potatoes were drenched in oil, looked ugly to eat and made us sick! The restroom was out of soap on Fri and on Mon it was still empty... coincidence I would have guessed but now I think not! The service was fine once it got going and the cheesecakes are always delish other then that this place has been removed from our list of fav places to eat when visiting Boise.

whatever you do, don't order from here. terrible service, delivery took forever and food was just bad. green tomatoes on sandwich. no cheesecake so they gave me fries? plenty of places to order from philly that are so much better!!

Pizza was good, that's why I gave it two stars, but the delivery was awful. Took over two hours to arrive and everything arrived cold. I called 3x and the lady told me 1 hour, but she did not tell me it would be close to 2 hours and calamari was all dried out! I used to order here all the time. Go for pick up option it's probably better
One person working, very rude and not responding.   Food took forever to come and definitely not a place I would recommend.  We were at hotel so to me reflects poorly on Hilton.  Can I give 0 stars.

Wow. I don't expect a lot of of airport restaurants, but this was abhorrent. 

Our waiter seemed harried and distracted. He took a long time to seat us, didn't return for our drink orders (another server did that), took a very long time to bring us our food (it was cold by arrival), and never brought us our check. The other server did that as well. He also took off during the meal, just shouting out that he would be back to the other workers. My pasta was cold and my husband's sandwich was burned to black and inedible, but we had no one to tell. We tried to tip the other server on duty-she was fabulous-but she refused. This guy needs to be retrained and fast, before someone misses a flight because of him.
Order took 2 hours. When I called twice they said out for delivery. Food arrived cold and hard. Worst pizza I have ever had.

My friends and I went here for dinner one night. It was a Friday I believe.  We were sat all the way in the back and ignored by our waitress. She took forever to come up to us. She was also pretty rude. The food was OK...nothing special. I would skip this place if I were you.

An omelette and biscuits & gravy took 35 minutes and were cold on arrival. Two tables that were seated 15 minutes after us had their food 20 minutes before us. Food was mediocre. Heard great things, did not live up to expectations. Will not go back. Totally unorganized from seating to serving.
Extremely slow service... Even on a slow night! Took forever for our appetizers to come out, and our entrees, oh and desert as well!
Everything was cold by the time it got here because apparently early the delivery driver decided to take two hours to deliver my food.

I'm giving this review 2 stars because the employee who I was dealing with seemed genuinely concerned that it took 2 hours to receive our food. Our food was mediocre, but I believe it was solely due to an inadequate delivery service. The driver was absent and took forever to deliver our food even though we were less than one mile from the restaurant. She showed up to the restaurant, left without the order and showed up nearly 40minutes later. The food was so late we ordered pizza before it was to late to get any food. I think tipping with this service should be done after the delivery. There was no way to change the dip and feel we should have been refunded it.

I can't think of one good thing to say about this place! Food was boring and so was the service. Took forever for the waitress to get to us! Drinks took forever and then the food was rushed! Salmon was very dry and my husbands entree was over cooked as well!! Would I return " NO" How do u take forever to get to us and our food is over cooked?? We won't be back!!! Too many good choices down here!!
Food took forever. Really need to work on kitchen issues. Won't be  back for a long time.

My best friend and I tried this place last night. We had looked at the menu beforehand and thought we'd give it a go. We walked in and got seated right away, however, that was the quickest moment once inside. We didn't see our waiter for a little bit and he came up and apologized for the wait and took our drink order but it took forever for us to actually get them. The food took forever to get to us considering it was burgers and fries. The food was indeed delicious and everyone got exactly what they ordered. I'd maybe do a takeout option here but service was so slow. Be prepared for it to take awhile if you go here.
Nice ambiance but lousy service. Was not that busy, but took forever to get drinks and get food ordered. Guacamole was fresh but the rest of food was just average.
Very clean and nice. Great price. Nice waitstaff, and has a takeout menu. Food was AMAZING

Ordered takeout from here during quarantine and it was delicious, fresh, and spicy! The food came really fast. We got the green papaya salad, crab rangoon, pad Thai, and crab fried rice. The crab fried rice was AMAZING. The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is the crab Rangoon was too sweet and too much turmeric for my liking. In hindsight I wish I would have gotten the crab and pork dumplings. Overall I would highly recommend.

Absolute gem in the middle of Metairie. Fast, cheap, great service, and, most importantly, delicious food. Wife orders takeout from here all the time, but we came in on a Friday night and there was no wait. Crispy Won Ton appetizer came out in about 30 seconds and was tasty. Pad See Ew entree was also tremendous. Will definitely be back.

Great food and friendly service. Gets busy! They offer walk-up takeout, call ahead and online orders for takeout, and delivery through doordash. 

I love their chili on basically any of their food. Always get their nuggets. 
Never skip the onion rings!
Old of this world milkshakes
Mediocre food, very slow service and higher prices. At least for takeout anyway.

First time there and will say it definitely will not be the last.  Ordered take-out ramen for my son and I. GREAT ramen.  Take-out ramen can be so-so, but the packaging was great noodles separate from the broth helped to make sure that the noodles kept their texture, etc.  

It is great to see a good restaurant come to the area.
Bad for Takeout - always one thing wrong with the order but Good food overall. I suggest going in instead of ordering out.

My boyfriend and I love this place! We discovered it a couple years ago when we were in town for a rugby tournament-we live in the suburbs in NY and have very few vegetarian or vegan places around (we are both vegetarians). Now we go every year after the tournament, even though it's really out of the way. Also, every time we visit my parents in NC, we detour to Philly on our way back solely to get dinner at HipCityVeg. It's totally out of the way, and we always have my dog so we get takeout and eat it in the car... We have to acknowledge it's kind of silly, it's usually rush hour and it adds over an hour to an 11-hour trip, but whatever, it's so good! My dog (NOT a vegetarian) always drools at us from the backseat-she really likes the Ziggy burger haha. The Philly Steak and sweet potato fries with Sriracha aoili are must haves for us. I almost gave it 4 stars instead of 5  because it's pretty expensive... But that is the price you pay for insisting your food doesn't come from the Sysco truck. Also I love supporting a business that gives a you-know-what about the planet- using all compostable packaging. Also the staff is great-pretty much a bunch of helpful happy hipsters haha. Love it!
Prettaaayy prettaayy prettay good.

Mikimoto makes it so easy to order takeout with their drive-thru pick-up window! I've ordered from here many times and always love how fast and convenient it is. I can vouch for the Rock 'n' Roll, gyoza, and shrimp tempura which are all great. I would also HIGHLY recommend the Baked Salmon appetizer. The salmon was cooked perfectly, the snowcrab inside was creamy, and there was a good amount of sauce on it without being overwhelming to the other flavors. Overall, I love Mikimoto for a quick sushi lunch!
I picked up takeout tonight. The tandoori chicken was very dry . The naan and chicken tikka masala were very good.
Fast and very friendly service! Odd location that's hard it get in and out of due to being in a gas station plaza, but it's good fast food.

I love this place! My friends and I get takeout here quite often, and we have enjoyed everything we've ordered so far. It is just takeout, so it's obviously nothing fancy, but great for what it is. (The crab rangoon is superb) The service is fast and friendly, and the pricing is great! It's always a stop we look forward to.

3.5*

Review for takeout

- Gnocchi  w/gorgonzola sauce - this was quite good.  The gnocchi was pillow soft and the sauce, despite being a cheese sauce, felt pretty light.

- Mushroom Risotto - we didn't really like this at all.  The risotto was a bit bland and a little tough.  We much preferred the pasta.

Takeout came with bread and Parmesan too.
It took over ten minutes to get my beer and there was a hair in it when I received it...Food is good, drink is good, service is terrible and I will only get takeout in the future.

Zesto is a nice place for lunch or dinner takeout if you work or stay in the area. The food is delicious, affordable, and the quantity is insanely huge! Although sometimes their fried stuff (fried chicken fingers) can be a little greasy but overall it's not too bad! 

This place mostly caters to junk, fast food; so healthy eaters may not find it amusing.
Bad experience. The girl at the register had a bad attitude and the food was awful. Worst Pretzel sandwich ever! The pretzel was wet, cold and soggy. Really bad. Couldn't eat it. Won't be back.
Fantastic food and Shelly is awesome! She made our first restaurant experience in New Orleans unforgettable! The shrimp poboy was great and HER grits were delicious!!

An employee came out the side door to try to confront me because I got upset at them for not giving me my order I had already paid $50 for on their app. I waited in my car 30 minutes for someone to bring my order. When no one did, I went through the drive thru. Then I was told they're out of most of the food I ordered. They're extremely unnecessarily rude and hostile. No one wears a mask. They're making food during a pandemic not wearing mask or gloves. This is definitely the worst restaurant of any kind I've ever been to and the worst experience I've ever had. I worked at a KFC when I was 15. It's fast food, I promise it's really not this hard. An hour later, I had no food and no refund. Called "corporate" and was promised a refund.
The worst experience I have ever received at any food established, poorly run manager was doing all the work while the employees dragged their feet in laziness
Probably the worst service I have ever had at a restaurant. It wasn't even busy. Not impressed with the sushi at all. Don't waste your money.

My service was terrible and I was forgotten about. My blackened salmon was so under cooked it was cold. They were sold out of vegetables. The order of wings I made to take home which was ordered in the middle of my meal I didn't receive until 35 min after I was finished with my meal. Overall the whole experience was one of the worst I have ever had at a restaurant. I travel for a living and eat out all the time. Don't waste your money here.
Never make order food from this place n don't wanna come again they give what they have in the restaurant not what we ordered. worst experience.
Worst experience ever. Ordered thru Uber Eats - 30 min delayed and then they gave my order to the wrong driver. Terrible customer service and bad food.

This was the absolute worst experience I have ever had at a steak and shake.  When we walked in there were 3 tables occupied every table not occupied had dirty dishes on them.  They had 2 servers the day we visited.  Saw many customers come in and it was taking so long to be seated most of them left.  We should have!
The worst experience ever!!!!

Konak claims it is located in a mansion-like environment.  In reality, it is one of the worst restaurant environments I have seen in years.  The room feels cavernous and lonely.  It is freezing cold inside the restaurant in the winter.

The service was generally poor and the food was very good.  As a fan of Turkish food, I was upset by the quality of the dishes they served us.  I can understand that it may be worthwhile when they have special deals, but outside of those nights it is not worth the price.
Worst restaurant ever. Been here twice in one month and both times it work over 1 hour to get our order and the food was cold

You know it's a good sign when you wake up the next day after a great restaurant experience and all you want to do it all over again.  After my first meal at Atlas all i could do was re-hash the whole thing. From meeting Henry the bartender to every single bite through dessert, it was great.  My favorite things about Atlas?  True neighborhood restaurant--regulars, laid back-people reading and drinking wine at the bar, chef coming out of the kitchen to shake customers hands, intimate setting, warm feel.  Even more, everything was cooked to perfection.  I savored every bite.  Try the ginger cake--euphoric.
The worst restaurant in the all entire area . This worker cursed at my Mother because I simply asked her if the order was ready or not ! Unbelievably mean and no class at all !

Unfortunately I have to credit this establishment with at least one star because yelp won't let you leave 0, otherwise I would. My husband and I had the worst restaurant experience in our lives at this place. We are locals and dine out 4-6 times a week and we sometimes like to come here but we will never be back after our last experience. My husband and I came without a reservation and the hostess asked us to wait at the bar. After waiting for over half an hour we realized there were three open tables. My husband had to let the hostess know there were open tables where we could sit. In the meantime, I was very cold sitting outside and so I went ahead and moved to the table. A server came and said to me this table is reserved you can't sit here, although there was no reserved sign anywhere to be seen. I told her I was cold and was simply sitting there until our table was ready to keep myself warm. After she walked away I was rudely approached by the manager, Chris. He told me to move from that table or to leave. He even offered to cancel our order! I was appalled and shocked at this rude treatment. There were three open tables, none with a reserved sign!! I told Chris that this is an inappropriate way to talk to customers and he did not seem to care at all. Soon after, another man interrupted our conversation. I had to ask him who he was because he didn't feel this need to introduce himself even though he was the owner. I told him that I was cold and wanted to sit at this open table and asked him if he could ask the people with the reservation that come later to sit at the outside table. His response was "well then the customer will be cold." Oh, right! Because I am not a customer! How silly of me! I told the owner how the manager was asking me to move or to leave and how inappropriate that was and his response was "what am I supposed to do? Fire him?" I told him all I wanted was to be talked to like a person and be treated respectfully because I am a paying customer. I also work with people and I know the customer is always right and you should always speak to them in a sincere way, not rudely telling them to leave. I am incredibly disappointed by the way my husband and I were treated. This was the most horrible dining experience I have ever had. If you don't want to be treated like a piece of dirt, I suggest avoiding backwater at all cost! Tourist or local, do not dine here, these owners and employees don't know the first steps of service and you will not have a good experience. Unfortunately this story is true and I would never take this much time out of my day to post this unless it was truly that horrible.

business_name: Hot Stuff Spicy Chicken and Fish
review_text: Probably the worst customer service ever. I asked the lady on the phone for a question and she was really rude and told me not to eat there. Worst experience ever!!!!!

Worst restaurant experience I ever had in my life. We were forced (!) to move from our seats to another table with no explanation or any apologies. Not even a "please" word! The server was super nervous for some reason that we were not aware of and forgot one of the drinks completely and ignored me couple of times. Food was not good either. Overpriced and tourist trap by all means. I really don't understand good reviews for this restaurant.

I love Mozzie's!!! But this was the worst experience I have ever had, when ordering at any restaurant. This is so uncalled for, our pizza was delivered this way "how dose this even happen" Once I called the manager as the driver left, he said and I quote" All I can do is replace and send out another pizza, or give you credit for another day. Ummmm excuse me poor management.

business_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
review_text:
Hey management
You are seriously going to have to hire expeditors and managers. If I want a hood experience, hood service and hood treatment in a hospitality environment then I will travel to the hood. What most people want is a restaurant experience. The service and experience was so poor I recommend to anyone that invests to sell any interest they have in this organization and start shorting immediately. This isn't a supportable business and is following the same downward trend as steak and shake.

A prefect restaurant for any family or friend celebration. The servers are friendly and very helpful. The food is amazing and very delicious especially the pasta a la Greco. This is my favorite dish and I highly recommend it!!
Plain and simple: my absolute favorite restaurant in New Orleans.
Excellent food.  I am glad I found it.  Right around the corner from my hotel.  I highly recommend this restaurant.
This restaurant is excellent. The service is always top notch and the food is amazing. I highly recommend it.
Recently opened gourmet hot dog restaurant. Highly recommend. Homemade rolls, cole slaw, chili, etc. No nitrate hot dogs and hand cut fries. Enthusiastic owner and attentive service.

This restaurant was highly recommended by the Sandpearl resort. This was our first time at this restaurant and it was highly disappointing. We had a nine pm reservation and we were rushed since they close at 10:00 pm. The service was very slow and our food order took an inordinate amount of time, particularly our grandson's dinner of Mac and cheese. Before we could finish our dinner, the staff started turning off lights which was highly unprofessional. My husband ordered a steak with a
Crab topping which was tasty but the presentation looked pretty sloppy. My daughter and I both ordered the Red Snapper pan seared and the presentation was also poor. The pan sear was only on the bottom of the snapper filets which made them look very pale an unappetizing. Overall a poor dining experience. My husband conveyed our dissatisfaction to the Manager and she seemed un-concerned. The waiter was very friendly and apologetic and showed empathy for our concerns. Would not recommend at all.
Wow, think we just found our new favorite restaurant in Tucson. Delicious food and friendly owners!
Very nice customer service and great cappuccino! Visiting from Orlando I'd highly recommend.

This Is one of my favorite restaurants. They have great drinks and great food. I have never had a bad meal here.  the staff members are very pleasant and nice. The restaurant has a great atmosphere as well. I highly recommend their meatballs, fungi pizza, and scallop dish. You cannot go wrong with anything on the menu here.
This used to be my favorite restaurant since I was 7 years but unfortunately the new owners know nothing about running a restaurant.  I see apartments or another WaWa there very soon.

I found this little gem of a restaurant on Yelp and I'm so glad I did. I ordered to brisket and it was very good. My friend ordered the ribs and she said they were delicious but my favorite was the corn bread. I love finding great restaurants off the beaten path, supporting small business. The food and service very fantastic. I highly recommend Four

I like all the foods of This Restaurant 
The ways they cook exactly like used to I been ate at California, foods come out very quick, no need to waiting that long .... 
most time a order Togo 10min I can pickup right away 
Bun with BBQ grill Beef, Bun Bo Hue spicy Beef soup noodles is my favorite...  most all kinds of foods all very tasty ... I m highly recommend this

business_name: New York New York Pizza - Carrollwood
review_text: This is my favorite pizza place! The staff is always friendly and my pizza has always been perfect. I love how easy online ordering is. We have always gotten pepperoni  and buffalo chicken. Highly recommend!
The reason there is a wait is because this place is AMAZING!!!!  One of my favorite places to go to.  I love VIP!  Highly recommend the Beef Tamole

My husband and I are so impressed with this place! We ordered take out so we could get home to watch the broncos play. The lady who took our order was super friendly and it took no time to get  our to-go. We had eggplant And meatballs with spaghetti. Flavored where amazing. So flavorful!! Can't wait to go back and eat at the restaurant. Highly recommend this place!!!
Authentic, very polite and delicious Korean food! Nice little hidden away mom-n-pop restaurant. Highly recommend to anyone wanting to try or once again eat authentic style Korean food.
I am so stoked to find this Mediterranean restaurant. I grew up with this kind of food and it's so authentic and delicious! I highly recommend this restaurant!

This place claims they have the best mimosas and they certainly deliver on this claim, I agree! I highly recommend getting the mimosa flight, you get to pick your flavors. My favorite was strawberry. Loved it here!
Our favorite restaurant in town! We eat our here frequently and the food and service is always great and consistent!  Brunch is amazing!

Came here with my wife for dinner.  Found the decor a bit bland.   Overall the food was ok.  The duck nachos sounded interesting but were not gooey enough.  The ingredients were not really mixed.   The short-rib mac and cheese were ok but nothing special.  For main entrees we had grilled tilapia and the lamb burger.

The grilled tilapia was ok but more like diner quality.   The lamb burger was delicious, though.   

Overall it was an average dining experience (except for the lamb burger) but not worth the price.

Delicious!  Gorgeous!  Very special!  
Eclairs are divine!  I could just list everything here but instead, I would tell you to just go, go, go! It's amazing and very very special

The service was pretty great - our server was attentive, friendly and answered all questions thoroughly. He kept coming back to check on us and was patient with our large group which we appreciated! The decor inside is OK.. a very casual vibe. The outside has a bunch of tables with string lights around that was kind of pretty but it was too cold for us to sit outside. 
Appetizer - chickpea fries and calamari were pretty good. And once we ordered it came out pretty fast. Entree was where things went off track. The paella was average nothing to write home about, the pesto chicken pasta was really bland and the basil salmon was nothing special. Overall the entrees were very underwhelming. Our friends ordered the scallops and mushroom risotto which they didn't like too much. The only person who enjoyed their dish had the Moroccan chicken. 
We didn't order dessert - their were only 3 choices. 
Unfortunately I don't think we will be back again, very average food, a fair meal to fill your stomach but nothing to entice your taste buds.
Very nice interior and atmosphere. Service was proficient but certainly not overly engaging. Food was average but really nothing stood out whatsoever.
Hamachi crudo was excellent! Cocktails were above average. Mussels were big and fresh.

Average food less than average service. The management team needs to do some serious training with this staff. 
From the rude hostess to the inexperienced bartenders I'd give this place a D-

When I visited Saint Louis in August, this was the place I wanted to visit, reviews and TV made it seem as the one to go. After my visit, I was highly disappointed. The restaurant and area are nice, and enjoyable, but the food is just ok. Nothing in the menu was special, I tried everything from the pizza to their specialties. Overall, just an average restaurant.

Average diner food.  Average prices.  Some food is better than others, bit as a whole you'll find something you like.

The mozarella sticks are awesome.

I ordered a bento box with chicken teriyaki and sushi. The sushi was good. It will not win any awards, but still better than average. I can't say the same thing about the chicken teriyaki. It was submerged in a sea of salty teriyaki sauce and tasted awful. The chicken was over cooked and chewy. The Shrimp tempera was ok! nothing special. The price is not bad and the service is better than average. Not sure if I would come back......

Went here for the chicken and waffles.  The chicken was just average, but fried well.  I wished the chicken and batter were more seasoned.  The waffle was just ok and the batter tasted average.  It is not the sweet type you would get at like Rosco's.
Been going to Rosario's since the 1980s and the pizza is just as good now as it was then. Steaks are above average too.  More of a take out place than eat in.
Food is average Mexican fare, service can be a bit slow.

We came here a few years back and really liked it, so came back again. This time around it was so-so... :-(

Most of what we ordered was pretty average and nothing special or memorable... however, the mushrooms with a goat cheese crouton were extremely good (really really really good!!!)...

Service was fair and it is a lovely environment...

We would recommend it, but we probably wouldn't come back again as we've since found many other restaurants that we believe are superior... Hope you enjoy it...

Don Memo's is a small clean place right by 69th street station that my friend tj kept telling me about.   we went in one day for lunch and were the only ones there we endured a long wait for average food that was inexpensive.  ho hum, nothing special.  returned with the wife and she liked it far better than me.  My wife is obsessed with the tortilla soup.  It is very good but I personally don't enjoy that dish.   upon a second and third try the chips and salsa are also, exceptional.  Other than that the food is solid with nothing really standing out to me.

My review is based on my average order, the three cheese steak special and regular fries. I've never tried anything else here so I cannot comment but this is the most fairly priced and decent quality cheese steak sandwich in the area.

Don't understand why such a high average review for this restaurant. Just ate there and found it to be below average and food is delivered cold.  Ribs have little flavor. Nachos are terrible.  Brisket was ok if you flood it with sauce.  I tried to think of something more positive to say but it is what it is.

We thought we would try something new.  I'm going with average.  We ordered beef medallions with mushrooms and a chicken pasta dish.  We received a lasagna dish to take home for free. $56.  No salads. Hard bread.  The divider between tables was very dusty.  We mentioned to employees when leaving.  Nothing really special.  Bathroom on second floor.  Overpriced and average

This pizza could pass to the naïve Californians, however for somebody born and raised in The Bronx New York, where some of the best pizza in America is made, this place is a fraud. First off, $4.58 plus tax for a slice of pizza is robbery, even if I loved the pizza I don't make enough money to eat here. In New York a slice is $2.50 MAX. The calzone I had was $10.99, it must have been huge right?  Well no, average size, average taste nothing special. I spent a little over $20 for something I could have had for under $10. This place might serve pizza that LOOKS like new York pizza, but it's a fraud don't go here. Plain and simple.

If you follow me, you know I only review places where I disagree with the current consensus. Bleu Sushi with a 4.5 star is a big surprise. I was so hyped to try this place, but found it very average. Nothing special to report and a little overpriced.

I didn't like that they wouldn't give tap water (thought that was a basic requirement?), forcing us to buy their Voss water.
